chapters.title: Chapter 910: The Apocalypse (14)
paragraphs: The more Lady Liora Kill, the darker the Yin half of the circle gets.
As this was happening, somewhere on the battlefield, Vari, who was making sure Lani was okay, turned slightly and looked in the direction of Lady Liora.
"The Yin-Yang Death Circle." On Vari’s forehead, the same circle appeared, but unlike Lady Liora, she had a perfect union, showing her life and death were balanced.
Of course, as the one heralded as the Mother of Assassins, she was destined to weave both life and death in perfect union.
However, Lady Liora wasn’t having it easy, for she had never truly managed to comprehend life as she had planned. She had made some progress, but it wasn’t enough to balance things out.
This was part of the reasons why she refused to join any Pill Alliance. She wasn’t looking for fame, for she was rather after life.

During her life as the Silent Angel, after many kills, she awakened the Yin-Yang Death Circle and quickly comprehended the essence of death, allowing her to gain control of the ’Yin’ aspect of her power.
However, the ’Yang’ was something she had been trying to comprehend for 15,000 years. Her master did her best to help her, and she had also done her best to gain some understanding.
However, with a great battle right at her doorstep, she knew it was time for her to fight, and so she dropped all caution and chose to kill.
But that also meant all her progress over the past 15,000 years was being washed down the drain.
Naturally, that was bad, and Vari, who knew this, chose to help her not because she was obligated to, but because she couldn’t in good conscience watch a fellow assassin fall into the darkness.
She just couldn’t, not when they were fighting for the same cause.
"She is losing control," Vari noted the change, so she turned toward Elaine. "Sweet baby sister Elaine, can you give me one of the Leaves of Life?"
Elaine, who was commanding the power of death, looked at Vari and then nodded. She extended her left arm, and a small golden leaf flew toward Vari.
"Thank you." Vari moved through the shadows, and soon she was beside Lady Liora.

"Take this. Press it against your forehead and let the energy flow through your body." Vari didn’t explain why she gave her the leaf, but Liora could already sense an extremely potent life energy coming from it, so she took it and did as she was told.
The moment the leaf touched her forehead, she felt her body lighten, and then a powerful life energy filled her.
"Allow it to flow through your body."

Vari instructed, and Lady Liora did as she was told. After a few more minutes, she felt her eyes gain a new clarity, and naturally, she sensed she had taken a step toward comprehending the essence of life.
Vari nodded, seeing the Yin-Yang Death Circle slowly start to stabilise.
"It isn’t a permanent fix, for you still have to comprehend Life. However, the energy running through your body will aid you, so go into seclusion right after the battle."
"Thank you," Lady Liora said, thanking Vari, who merely nodded and vanished, appearing beside Lani, who was doing her best to wipe as many tattoos off her body.
On one side of the battlefield, Zaila was hovering in the air, four runic symbols revolving around her. Her hands were moving in the air, making her appear like a music conductor.
However, if one looked much closer, they would see she was doing more than just moving her hands through the air.
What many weren’t seeing was that she was pulling on invisible threads, each coated in life energy and soul energy. If Dori were to see her now, she would be very proud.
"Almost there," Zaila muttered, looking at the strings before her.

"Zaila, what is the update?" Kaizo asked, seeing the pressure mounting on his teammates. Fighting thousands of Spirit Ascension, Kings, and Emperors wasn’t that simple for beings merely in the Core formation stage.
"I am almost there, Kaizo, no need to keep asking every few seconds."
Below her, hundreds of thousands of Vampires lay passed out.
Kaizo looked at Zaila for a split second before a smirk appeared on his lips, and he muttered, "What an uptight beauty Master has in his harem."
"I heard that," Zaila didn’t look at Kaizo, but she smiled, focusing intently on her work.
If what she was doing was successful, then they would gain more men to face the danger that would pour out from the Forsaken Door the moment the seal loses its power.
And since Yi Lai couldn’t use the same attack on the door twice, it was safe to say that the moment the seal was lifted, the true danger of the battle would come through.
So Kaizo and his team had to hurry, for the clock was ticking.
"Almost there," Zaila muttered again, weaving the memory strands like she was a Mind Weaver.
Suddenly, a powerful blood energy burst out, covering the entire battlefield. Many turned and looked in the direction from which the explosion came.
There was blood mist everywhere, hiding the one who caused the explosion.
The mist was thick and contained so much death qi that it caused the disciples still standing at the edge of the battlefield to turn pale, some even passing out.
They hadn’t been under that much aura, not even when the Spirit Emperors appeared. However, this blood mist was so potent that they started collapsing one after another.
Sylara, who had been in the air for almost an hour, revealed herself from the mist, exuding a powerful blood aura.
She was clad in her black, spiky, jagged armour, her claws extending a few inches longer this time.
When everyone saw her, their backs broke into a cold sweat.
If Kent were around, he would laugh and call the Evil One-Eyed Demoness a mega evil, for that is what she had become.
Of course, Sylara was relatable, for on a normal day, she had two eyes just like everyone else. That change was thanks to having a True Name.
However, hovering in the air with her bloody claws exuding danger, she had turned into her battle form, now having only one eye, and it was red, burning with blood flames.
When she took a step, the space beneath her feet cracked, but it closed the next second. However, the more steps she took, the more these cracks continued to appear.
When she was finally hovering above the battlefield, she unleashed a powerful aura that affected everyone. The effect was more devastating on the Forsaken warriors than on her side.
"Uhm, Madam Vampire, time for you to get back to work... We need all Claws on deck," Kaizo said to Sylara, who glanced at him before turning back to the Forsaken warriors.
"Blood Transformation," Sylara muttered.
"First Seal." A blood-red rune appeared on her forehead, radiating a potent blood and death qi.
"Blood Hunger."
Her red eye lit up, and a beam so powerful it cut through hundreds of Forsaken warriors shot out. Some had holes in them with many severed in half.
"Hahaha... That’s what I am talking about," Kaizo laughed, feeling a hidden energy rise within him. "Give them hell, Sylara."
The One-Eyed Demoness moved, and death followed.

chapters.title: Chapter 911: The Apocalypse (15)
paragraphs: Sylara moved like a blur, exuding only a red aura in the air as she gutted one Forsaken warrior after another.
She wasn’t aiming for any other body parts besides their throats.
She used her razor-sharp claws to dig into a forsaken warrior’s throat and pull their guts out.
It was brutal and bloody.
The crazy ways in which she was killing were just too jaw-dropping and throat-choking.
Kaizo, who was up in the air, was laughing like a maniac as he clashed with five Peak Spirit Emperors, making no effort to kill them, nor they him.
Uncle Drake, on the other hand, had already killed three Peak Spirit Emperors, and he was now surrounded by two Peak Spirit Emperors and four Level 8 Spirit Emperors.

Kaizo was paying attention to the passing of time, so when five minutes had passed and still there were thousands of Forsaken warriors on the battlefield, he knew something had to change. However, looking around, all his teammates were busy with their battles.
He tried to come up with different formations, but no matter how he saw it, there was nothing he could change.
But the unruly, battle-hungry Kaizo was more brilliant than Vexthra gave him credit for.
"Elaine, do you happen to have one of those golden leaves?"
Elaine, who was doing death’s work, nodded, sparing no effort to look at Kaizo. She was making sure her main attack—or more like her only mega trump card—worked in the end.
Kaizo smiled. "You wouldn’t mind giving me one, would you?"
This time, Elaine looked at him for a second before extending her hand. The Leaf of Life appeared and flew toward Kaizo.
"You are a lifesaver, Elaine."

With the Leaf of Life in his hand, Kaizo looked at Uncle Drake, who was spraying deadly flames at the pitiful Forsaken warriors who didn’t know they would be facing abnormally dangerous warriors in what was promised to be an easy and safe invasion and massacre.
Safe to say they didn’t expect this outcome, not even in the slightest.
But who could blame them?

Kent knew the danger coming, so he intentionally didn’t allow his legion to roam this world. This was why Amix, the leader of the Hand, didn’t know of people like Nara, who was riding her Nightmare Horse, and Elaine, who had the Tree of Death behind her, marking thousands of Forsaken warriors with the seal of death.
It was outside of their expectations.
"Uncle Drake, up it to 13% and use the momentum to kill as many as you can within the next 20 minutes. I have a way for you to recover to your top strength instantly."
Uncle Drake, in his dragon form, looked at Kaizo and asked, "Are you sure?"
Kaizo smiled. "The reason why I’m the one leading the battle is simply because I don’t make empty decisions. So trust me and go berserk, I got you."
Although Uncle Drake didn’t really know much about Kaizo. However, knowing he was Kent’s subordinate was all he needed to trust him.
Thus, Uncle Drake, who was using 8% of his bloodline, let loose and activated 13% of it. The moment he activated 13% of his bloodline, everybody felt the heat.
The Forsaken warriors close to him melted just from the deep red flames that touched their bodies.
"Go berserk, Uncle Drake! Show them who the boss is!" Kaizo cheered on Uncle Drake, who rose into the air and took a nose dive, bringing with him a deadly pool of flames.
"What in the hell?" the Sect Leader, who was also in his dragon form but surrounded by lightning, shouted when he saw the tsunami of flames falling from the sky.
"Move back!"
He shouted, causing the disciples and the warriors of Sonox still on the battlefield to retreat as fast as they could.
Some who were even about to kill their targets chose to abandon them and move back.
"Witness the flame of a true dragon."
Uncle Drake’s voice boomed as he descended, slamming his thick legs on the ground.
BOOM
Upon impact, flames exploded everywhere. In an instant, a 2 km radius around him was consumed by bone-melting flame. Screams of pain and anguish spread everywhere.
The flames didn’t stop immediately; they continued to spread and spread, consuming those pushed back by the initial impact.
The more it moved, the more painful cries filled the battlefield.
"Hahahahaha..." Suddenly, a cold and sinister laughter came from the crack leading to Sonox, "Now, this is a battle worthy of Night Riders."
Two Nightmare Horses appeared through the portal, green flames burning after them. One was a lady wielding a bone-like bow, and the other was a man holding a bone-like staff.
"Witness the might of Umbra Arcanis," Eryndor, the third Night Rider whom Kent had sent to spy on the Dark Devil Church right after his awakening, shouted as he pointed his bone-like staff forward.
"Rise"
From the ground, three deadly gates made from the bones of forbidden beasts rose, and from within their green flame portals, three beings appeared.
It took just one look to know they were beasts in human form.
The first had the body of a giant human and the head of a goat, with horns so large and twisted that just looking at them made one feel the urge to run. He held a massive machete.
The second had the head of a tiger and a stone-like body. He wielded a jagged spear.
The third had the head of a serpent and a human body, his skin pigmented with tiger patterns.
"Show them hell!" Eryndor shouted, causing his three summons to attack. They charged forward, and like the beings of hell they were, they began slaughtering the Forsaken warriors.
Saden, the second Night Rider after Uncle Drew, rode her Nightmare Horse toward Nara’s location. "How have you been, Big Sister?" Saden asked.
Nara beheaded a Spirit King before she turned to Saden and smiled. "As you can see, I’ve never felt better."
Saden smiled.
She and Eryndor had gone to hell to handle a matter Eryndor needed her help with.
Naturally, Eryndor had taken it upon himself to destroy the Dark Devil Church without even asking for Kent’s permission. Not that Kent would have stopped him.
After all, Kent also wanted them destroyed, which was why he had sent Eryndor to spy on them in the first place.

However, after destroying the sinister organisation and saving thousands, Eryndor went on a quest in hell to search for capable summons, since the ones in Sonox were weak, and he didn’t want to appear weak—not when their leader was known as the greatest warrior to have ever walked the face of the universe.
He sought Saden’s help, and after many years there—since time ran much faster in hell—they had just returned, only to find themselves stepping into a battlefield.
"Get to work, Saden. The leader hasn’t returned from the Underworld yet, and Kent is also busy, so it’s up to us to keep everyone alive."
Saden nodded and pulled her bowstring, manifesting a deadly green arrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 912: The Apocalypse (16)
paragraphs: With the arrival of Eryndor and Saden, the battle was slowly turning in Kaizo’s favour, gaining a foothold.
Uncle Drake was rampaging everywhere, making sure that before exhaustion kicked in, he would clear a large chunk of the enemy. After all, he had activated his bloodline and was using 13% of it.
Sylara was also doing her unholy massacre, with every kill fueling her strength.
The Blood Hunger Seal she had created was the fuel she was depending on at the moment. Whenever she killed, the seal on her forehead shone brightly, absorbing the core blood of the slain.
It wasn’t like Lady Liora and her disciples’ flame runes.

Sylara’s own seal aimed for the purest essence blood of the people she killed. It was one of the reasons why vampires with Blood Transformation are feared. There are many seals they can create with unimaginable powers.
With every kill, her strength increased. The best part was that this change was permanent. So, if her power increases by 200% today, it will remain that way forever.
After the battle, the strength of the Blood Hunger Seal would remain, so the next battle would be about her merely activating the seal, and the massacre would continue.
It had already been 20 minutes since the door was sealed, and while Kaizo’s side was clearly dominating the forsaken warriors, their number was still higher than theirs.
Kaizo looked and saw that most of the warriors from Sonox had retreated, with even some of the main generals of the various kingdoms also retreating.

It was only normal for them, for the highest they were able to fight were Spirit Ascension stage warriors. The rest were much stronger than they could handle, so the only logical thing was for them to retreat.
"At this rate, the chances of us ending this batch of forsaken warriors before the main force comes through are slim." Kaizo looked at the battle happening around him and sighed.
He was now free to slaughter the weaker farosaken warriors since the Peak Spirit Emperors fighting him went to stop Uncle Drake and the three Hell Beasts Eryndor had summoned on the battlefield.
"Though we still have our trump cards intact, there is no telling what will be walking out of that door next."
Kaizo looked at Tribe Chief Malthar, who held a large axe and kept swinging at the forsaken warriors.
On his side, every last Bloodvein warrior was still in battle, fighting with all they had. They were showing the various kings and queens that they weren’t weaklings.
"I was waiting for the main force to appear before doing anything. However, if I don’t risk it now, it will be too late." Kaizo pondered and chose to take the risk.
"Tribe Chief Malthar, use the formation."
The moment the order was given, Tribe Chief Malthar unleashed his chaos aura, causing the air around him to turn chaotic.
The forsaken warriors within a five-meter radius of him felt their hearts shudder just by being near him.
"Bloodvein Tribe, activate the formation."
The thousands of red-skinned warriors on the battlefield stopped mid-attack and unleashed their own chaos aura as well.
Every last one of them released their aura and then channelled it through their weapons. The weapons in their hands shuddered, flew from their grips, and hovered a couple of inches away.
They formed identical hand seals and pointed them at their weapons. Red beams shot from their weapons, infused with both chaos and blood energy.
When the beams met, a red formation appeared wide in the sky, immediately causing the thousands of forsaken warriors inside the formation to feel something very heavy crash down on their shoulders.
"Bloodvein Chaos Blood Killing Formation... Activate!"
Tribe Chief Malthar flew into the air and hovered just below the formation.
"Change formation!" The thousands of Bloodvein warriors formed another hand seal, and the patterns in the formation shifted.
"First formation... Blood Rain!"

From within the formation, crimson blood started raining down on the battlefield. The forsaken warriors within the formation’s coverage felt the blood land on them, but strangely, none of them felt any discomfort.
They all expected something bad to happen, but all they felt was the coldness that came from the blood.
Naturally, they wondered what that was for. However, with nothing bad happening to them, many of them eased the pressure on their bodies, aiming to move and kill the redskin warriors.
But by the time they managed to wiggle a few strands of the pressure off their bodies, they were all bathed in the red blood.
Far in the distance, Velyra, who saw this, smiled. "Idiots. Do you really think something that thousands of warriors channel their energies into will be that simple?"
As if right on cue, Tribe Chief Malthar commanded again, "Change formation."
The Bloodvein warriors formed another hand seal, and the formation changed. The moment the formation shifted, the blood rain stopped, and the pressure on every last forsaken warrior was lifted.
However, the next second, the danger they hadn’t expected came.
"Second Formation... Blood Curse."
Every last Bloodvein turned pale when the second formation was unleashed. The second form drained them drastically.
However, while they went pale, on every last forsaken warrior’s forehead, the blood that had rained on them formed a red seal.
The seal moved and entered their foreheads.
In that instance, the commanding voice that none of them could disobey entered their minds.
"KILL."

Every last forsaken warrior with the seal on their forehead moved, and in the next second, the battle that was supposed to be between the warriors of Sonox and the forsaken race had now turned into a battle between the forsaken race and the Blood-Cursed forsaken race.
"What is happening?" a Peak Spirit Emperor forsaken warrior asked when he was attacked by another Peak Spirit Emperor.
"This is..." Lady Enzi muttered, looking at this deadly display with a shocked expression.
Lady Liora, however, looked at Tribe Chief Malthar, who was flying away from the battlefield with his warriors, and narrowed her eyes.

"I know this formation, but I can’t seem to recall where I saw it. However, I learned this formation is capable of taking possession of even immortals, considering the people who cast it have the energy to power it.
In the high world, many armies run when this formation is deployed. It is the bane of every army.
To think it would be used on the same battlefield I was fighting on. I am blessed, I guess."
Lady Liora bowed slightly toward the retreating backs of the drained warriors. Lady Enzi studied the look in Lady Liora’s eyes for a few seconds and sighed.
"But would this be enough?" she asked, looking in Kaizo’s direction.
The Unyielding Titan hovered in the air, exuding the aura of confidence. He didn’t look like someone out of options.
Whenever people turned and looked at him, all they saw was a confident warrior with a commanding presence that didn’t cower before the enemy.
Perhaps that was why the universe picked him to lead while Kent was away.
’He will have a way.’ Everyone looking at him thought the same thing in their hearts.
"Finally." Just when everyone was staring at the massacre between the forsaken warriors, Zaila’s sweet and happy tone entered their minds, causing them all to turn in her direction.
Kaizo looked at her and smiled. "Is it done?" he asked.
Zaila nodded and clapped her hands. "Wake up."
On the ground, over 140,000 zombies woke up and flew into the air with the Vampire King standing in the front.
"What is your command, General Zaila?"
The smile on Zaila’s face brightened.

sentences.text: With the arrival of Eryndor and Saden, the battle was slowly turning in Kaizo’s favour, gaining a foothold.
Uncle Drake was rampaging everywhere, making sure that before exhaustion kicked in, he would clear a large chunk of the enemy.
After all, he had activated his bloodline and was using 13% of it.
Sylara was also doing her unholy massacre, with every kill fueling her strength.
The Blood Hunger Seal she had created was the fuel she was depending on at the moment.
Whenever she killed, the seal on her forehead shone brightly, absorbing the core blood of the slain.
It wasn’t like Lady Liora and her disciples’ flame runes.
Sylara’s own seal aimed for the purest essence blood of the people she killed.
It was one of the reasons why vampires with Blood Transformation are feared.
There are many seals they can create with unimaginable powers.
With every kill, her strength increased.
The best part was that this change was permanent.
So, if her power increases by 200% today, it will remain that way forever.
After the battle, the strength of the Blood Hunger Seal would remain, so the next battle would be about her merely activating the seal, and the massacre would continue.
It had already been 20 minutes since the door was sealed, and while Kaizo’s side was clearly dominating the forsaken warriors, their number was still higher than theirs.
Kaizo looked and saw that most of the warriors from Sonox had retreated, with even some of the main generals of the various kingdoms also retreating.
It was only normal for them, for the highest they were able to fight were Spirit Ascension stage warriors.
The rest were much stronger than they could handle, so the only logical thing was for them to retreat.
"At this rate, the chances of us ending this batch of forsaken warriors before the main force comes through are slim." Kaizo looked at the battle happening around him and sighed.
He was now free to slaughter the weaker farosaken warriors since the Peak Spirit Emperors fighting him went to stop Uncle Drake and the three Hell Beasts Eryndor had summoned on the battlefield.
"Though we still have our trump cards intact, there is no telling what will be walking out of that door next."
Kaizo looked at Tribe Chief Malthar, who held a large axe and kept swinging at the forsaken warriors.
On his side, every last Bloodvein warrior was still in battle, fighting with all they had.
They were showing the various kings and queens that they weren’t weaklings.
"I was waiting for the main force to appear before doing anything.
However, if I don’t risk it now, it will be too late." Kaizo pondered and chose to take the risk.
"Tribe Chief Malthar, use the formation."
The moment the order was given, Tribe Chief Malthar unleashed his chaos aura, causing the air around him to turn chaotic.
The forsaken warriors within a five-meter radius of him felt their hearts shudder just by being near him.
"Bloodvein Tribe, activate the formation."
The thousands of red-skinned warriors on the battlefield stopped mid-attack and unleashed their own chaos aura as well.
Every last one of them released their aura and then channelled it through their weapons.
The weapons in their hands shuddered, flew from their grips, and hovered a couple of inches away.
They formed identical hand seals and pointed them at their weapons.
Red beams shot from their weapons, infused with both chaos and blood energy.
When the beams met, a red formation appeared wide in the sky, immediately causing the thousands of forsaken warriors inside the formation to feel something very heavy crash down on their shoulders.
"Bloodvein Chaos Blood Killing Formation...
Activate!"
Tribe Chief Malthar flew into the air and hovered just below the formation.
"Change formation!" The thousands of Bloodvein warriors formed another hand seal, and the patterns in the formation shifted.
"First formation...
Blood Rain!"
From within the formation, crimson blood started raining down on the battlefield.
The forsaken warriors within the formation’s coverage felt the blood land on them, but strangely, none of them felt any discomfort.
They all expected something bad to happen, but all they felt was the coldness that came from the blood.
Naturally, they wondered what that was for.
However, with nothing bad happening to them, many of them eased the pressure on their bodies, aiming to move and kill the redskin warriors.
But by the time they managed to wiggle a few strands of the pressure off their bodies, they were all bathed in the red blood.
Far in the distance, Velyra, who saw this, smiled.
"Idiots.
Do you really think something that thousands of warriors channel their energies into will be that simple?"
As if right on cue, Tribe Chief Malthar commanded again, "Change formation."
The Bloodvein warriors formed another hand seal, and the formation changed.
The moment the formation shifted, the blood rain stopped, and the pressure on every last forsaken warrior was lifted.
However, the next second, the danger they hadn’t expected came.
"Second Formation...
Blood Curse."
Every last Bloodvein turned pale when the second formation was unleashed.
The second form drained them drastically.
However, while they went pale, on every last forsaken warrior’s forehead, the blood that had rained on them formed a red seal.
The seal moved and entered their foreheads.
In that instance, the commanding voice that none of them could disobey entered their minds.
"KILL."

Every last forsaken warrior with the seal on their forehead moved, and in the next second, the battle that was supposed to be between the warriors of Sonox and the forsaken race had now turned into a battle between the forsaken race and the Blood-Cursed forsaken race.
"What is happening?" a Peak Spirit Emperor forsaken warrior asked when he was attacked by another Peak Spirit Emperor.
"This is..." Lady Enzi muttered, looking at this deadly display with a shocked expression.
Lady Liora, however, looked at Tribe Chief Malthar, who was flying away from the battlefield with his warriors, and narrowed her eyes.
"I know this formation, but I can’t seem to recall where I saw it.
However, I learned this formation is capable of taking possession of even immortals, considering the people who cast it have the energy to power it.
In the high world, many armies run when this formation is deployed.
It is the bane of every army.
To think it would be used on the same battlefield I was fighting on.
I am blessed, I guess."
Lady Liora bowed slightly toward the retreating backs of the drained warriors.
Lady Enzi studied the look in Lady Liora’s eyes for a few seconds and sighed.
"But would this be enough?" she asked, looking in Kaizo’s direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 913: The Apocalypse (17)
paragraphs: If Soul Cultivators are regarded as dangerous, then Mind Cultivators are a calamity.
Zaila is a Mind Cultivator, and a terrifying one at that.
She had great control over her abilities to the point that if Kent were to measure against her in skill mastery, he would find that Zaila had perfect mastery over all her skills.
This means she could use them flawlessly, and that was exactly what she did.
In a battle that defied all odds, she knew they needed an army and, more importantly, they needed a disposable army that couldn’t disobey commands.
The vampires who were planning on using the chaos of the battle to slip through the cracks and escape never had the chance.

Zaila didn’t allow their plans to bear fruit, for she knocked them out before they could even think of it. Of course, she could have killed them using her strongest attack, which was a skill called ’Mind Bomb’.
However, she merely put them to sleep and chose to weave their memories. Of course, she could have done that by merely controlling their minds.
However, knowing that using a skill to control their minds would limit their combat prowess, Zaila took the long way, and that was the complete weaving of their memories.
She first wiped their memories clean and then wove new ones for them. In this new reality, they were loyal warriors of General Zaila.
In a way, she turned them into dummies she could command, and they would listen to her orders without any resistance while fighting using their peak abilities.
"Clear the battlefield as quickly as you can," Zaila commanded, and the 140,000-plus vampires charged forward and started killing like crazy.
They were stronger than the sect and the warriors of Sonox combined, so their battle power was very high. This made the battle much more lively.
The blood curse was having the most impact, to the point that aside from Sylara, Uncle Drake, and Lani, alongside the vampires, everyone else had retreated.
"These are Tier 14 Recovery Pills. They will speed up your recovery." Lady Liora handed out hundreds of pill bottles to the warriors, causing many to bow down toward her.
With only two minutes left for the seal to come down, Kaizo called Uncle Drake back and handed him the ’Leaf of Life’.
The moment he took it, the fatigue he felt was washed away, leaving him with an abundance of energy.

"I have a feeling our winning or losing will be determined by the danger that will be passing through that gate any moment from now," Lady Enzi said, standing beside Lady Liora and Sect Leader Deimos.

"This is a win-or-lose battle in which either we die or they do. Naturally, I plan on ascending, so I won’t be dying today," Sect Leader Deimos said as he turned to Lady Liora and Enzi. "When it comes to it, I will burn my life force to keep going."

The two raised their brows but didn’t say anything. They knew he meant business, and as someone who valued his life above everything, they knew he wouldn’t make this decision if he didn’t have life to spare.
As someone who was only at the Core Formation stage, his lifespan should have ended when he turned 15,000 years old. However, he had more years to live than a cockroach.
This was a result of the limits he had broken on his body.
The moment one breaks a limit, their lifespan is doubled. So for someone like Old Deimos, who had broken his 8th limit, he had more years to spare.
"Old Sword would be pissed if he found out a battle of this magnitude happened just a few months after he ascended."
Sect Leader Deimos laughed.
Though he didn’t appear to be the social type, he actually had a good relationship with every last elder in the sect.
"Let’s just end this as fast as we can." Right when Lady Liora said those words, the Forsaken Gate shook, and a powerful aura came from it. Then the green colour slowly started turning red.

Kaizo floated over the battlefield, and his voice boomed as he spoke, "Whatever comes through that door is an enemy, and as such, we must kill them. However, if it is beyond you, then kindly retreat. There is no shame in retreating.
That said, use your trump cards and don’t allow the enemy to overwhelm us."
His words ended with a powerful boom that broke the sound barrier. Through the gate, five powerful figures flew through at a speed that sent a shockwave across the entire battlefield.
An oppressive pressure fell from the sky, causing all who were hovering in the air to come crashing down, Kaizo included.
Everyone coughed up a mouthful of blood, with many passing out instantly.
"Ants... time for you to meet your end."
Inside the tower, Vexthra’s body shook, and a faint divine aura came from her body, but she held herself back. Though she looked very pale.
"Heavenly Ascension... however, are they going to—" Her words came to a halt when she saw two ethereal beauties appear from Unity’s forehead.
"This..." Her expression changed from shock to fear.
On the battlefield, the moment the five appeared, Unity’s two Primordial Spirit bodies emerged, each radiating the aura of a Spirit Lord.
Naturally, among her sisters, she was the only one whose Primordial Spirits had not yet started walking the Ancient Godly Path. This meant they still had their Tier 18 cultivation bases.
Feisty held a bow and arrow in her firm grip, and Blossom wielded a much larger paintbrush.
In Unity’s hand, a thick arrow appeared. She sat down in a lotus posture and started to channel her energy into the arrow.
"Give me ten minutes, you two." Unity’s two Primordial Spirit bodies nodded, and they charged toward the five Heavenly Ascension stage Forsaken Elders that had appeared.
"Relax, everyone, we will hold them back." Blossom was the first to attack. She waved the paintbrush and made quick, decisive strokes that mirrored her painting on a canvas.

"Why don’t we take this somewhere more private?" She pressed the brush forward, and the entire 12 km before them turned into a painting on a canvas. The five Forsaken Elders were immediately caught within.
"Feisty’s Lazy Art Domain!" Blossom activated the domain she had come up with on a whim, and in an instant, a 12 km-wide canvas covered the sky.

"This is... unbelievable." Vexthra, who had been worried, sighed slightly when she saw the painting appear. Though she hadn’t expected Unity to unleash both spirit bodies of hers, she sighed in relief, knowing that inside a domain, the creator has some leeway.
Also, she could sense that the arrow in Unity’s hands wasn’t simple, and since she requested only ten minutes, her spirit bodies would be able to hold on, or at least not die.
The next second, 70,000-plus Forsaken warriors ranging from Spirit Ascension to Spirit Emperors appeared through the door, joining the ones already there.

chapters.title: Chapter 914: The Apocalypse (18) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "What in the hell?" one Spirit Emperor who had just arrived on the battlefield muttered, looking at the thousands of his kind killing each other.
"What kind of madness is this?"
They just didn’t understand what was happening. However, when the first Blood-Cursed Forsaken charged at them, they all charged forward.
Behind them, 10,000 Spirit Monarchs, 5,000 Spirit Sovereigns, and 1,000 Spirit Lords also appeared, showing that the Forsaken race meant business this time around.

They had sent out all their warriors, including five Heavenly Ascension stage warriors, leaving only five Heavenly Ascension stage warriors in their world. They were waiting for the one they called their Lord.
But on the battlefield, the moment every last Forsaken warrior appeared, Kaizo looked at Camilla and nodded. "Time for you to do your thing."
Camilla nodded and flew into the air. She threw a spear into the sky and made it float. Then she formed a hand seal, and from within the spear, an ethereal figure appeared, towering over Camilla.
Looking at her appearance, one could say she resembled Camilla almost exactly.
She took hold of the spear, which expanded several times until its shadow covered a large part of the battlefield.
"Spear Manifestation: Collapsing Thrust!"
The towering figure behind Camilla stabbed the spear at the thousands of Forsaken warriors, causing a collapsing force to shoot out at the approaching enemies.
The spear and the pressure behind it landed hard on the ground, and in that very moment, a red light flashed through the air.

Just the thrust from the spear alone was enough to kill a thousand. However, using the chaos that followed, Neomi moved and made sure she was within the midst of the disoriented Forsaken warriors before she clapped her hands and vanished into the ground.
From where she vanished, a pool of dark water appeared and immediately spread throughout a major part of the battlefield.
"Hands of the Fallen... Pull!"
Neomi appeared far from where she had vanished with a pale face.
However, the Forsaken warriors who weren’t quick enough felt powerful hands grab onto their legs, and with one swift pull, they vanished into the dark water, never to be seen again.
Neomi moved back, catching her breath.
The skill Camilla used was powerful, but it wasn’t among her trump cards. In fact, it was merely something she and her weapon spirit came up with when she was unconscious months back.
However, the one Neomi used was one of her two trump cards.
It wasn’t a skill she could use in close combat. But the ’Hands of the Fallen’ skill is deadly in large battles.
The black water that appeared naturally contained death qi. But that wasn’t all. It also carried the resentment of all the people she had killed.
And the best part was that the strength of all she had killed was merged into one entity, making it several times deadly. This was even the reason why some Spirit Lords had fallen prey to her skill.
But that also meant she wouldn’t be able to join the battle anytime soon.
However, all this was within Kaizo’s calculations.
"Camilla, do it again and make it go boom this time."

Camilla nodded and raised her spear up. The lady who had manifested behind her was gone now. However, the moment she raised her spear, an oppressive force came down from the clouds, forcing the Forsaken warriors to turn pale.
Camilla also turned pale, for she had unleashed one of her three trump cards, draining a large chunk of her energy.

Lightning flashed across the sky as a large blue ring, and a giant hand inside appeared slowly. At one glance, one might think an immortal had arrived on the battlefield, for the aura coming from it was too great.
"Forsaken Formation!" The Spirit Lords immediately formed hand seals and raised their fingers up. However, the formation they manifested crashed the next second when the ring started spinning.
"Move back, everyone," Kaizo commanded, and all warriors, including the vampires, moved back.
"Seven Elemental Spinning Disc!"

Camilla formed a hand seal and made her spear fly up and enter the spinning disc. The moment it did, the edges of the spinning disc manifested thousands of pointed spears, causing the spinning to intensify.
This gesture drained her even more.
"Cut through!" With a weak gesture, the spinning disc moved, and the Forsaken warriors began screaming.
Be it the new arrivals, the old ones, or the blood-cursed ones, the spinning disc shredded through them, their blood-soaked screams erupting from their souls.
Camilla, just like Neomi, also vanished into the tower.
Next to move was Ingrid.
Kaizo’s plan was simple. Since they couldn’t fight the Forsaken Clan head-on anymore, they would thin down their numbers by using their trump cards and hope things worked out in the end.
Ingrid floated just 300 meters away from the Forsaken warriors and clapped her palms together. Then her eyes turned dark, almost as if she could see through the void.
Naturally, she could see through the void.
She slowly began to open her palm, causing a small black dot to appear between the palms that were opening.
"Are we safe?" Kaizo asked, looking at the Forsaken warriors who were charging toward Ingrid. He didn’t panic, for he knew this was exactly what Ingrid was after.
Instinctively, he took a few steps back just in case.
One of the Spirit Lords got close and stabbed his sword forward. However, just when his sword’s cold edge could touch Ingrid, she vanished, and in her place, the black dot she was holding appeared.
Then a voice came from the void, filling the entire space...
"Void Swallow!"
The small black dot instantly expanded and exuded a powerful suction force, swallowing everything within a 4km radius. Naturally, that was a lot of Forsaken warriors.

The dot then shrank again, and Ingrid, with a pale face, appeared. She took hold of it and shattered it in a firm grip. From all over the battlefield, the void started tearing open, throwing out dead bodies.
When the last corpse fell, the Forsaken warriors realised they weren’t fighting an equal battle. Fear gripped them.
But before they could process what was happening, a sweet yet dangerous voice entered their heads.
"Blossom, draw the lines. Feisty, augment me."
Unity rose into the air, causing the atmosphere around her to shift dangerously. Inside the painting, Blossom moved back and drew five lines, each merging at one end.
"Form," her sweet voice echoed from within the painting as the lines moved and merged with the five Heavenly Ascension stage experts trapped inside.
Feisty, on the other hand, merged with Unity’s body, causing her energy to rise severalfold. Then she moved and entered the painting.
Inside the painting, Unity appeared in a real place, though on the outside, she looked as though she was painted into the painting
"Time for you to die." Perhaps it was a coincidence, but the words she spoke in the painting echoed to the outside, causing every last Forsaken warrior to pale.
Then it happened.
The lines that Blossom drew and linked to the five Forsaken Elders formed a bullseye, and that was where Unity aimed.
"This is going to hurt," Blossom muttered.
"Soul Extinguishing Arrow!"
The arrow flew and landed dead centre in the bullseye. For a moment, nothing happened. But then Unity coughed up blood and turned pale.
Blossom and Feisty also flickered and then vanished.
The painting unravelled, and six figures fell from the air.

"Forsaken Formation!" The Spirit Lords immediately formed hand seals and raised their fingers up.
However, the formation they manifested crashed the next second when the ring started spinning.
"Move back, everyone," Kaizo commanded, and all warriors, including the vampires, moved back.
"Seven Elemental Spinning Disc!"
Camilla formed a hand seal and made her spear fly up and enter the spinning disc.
The moment it did, the edges of the spinning disc manifested thousands of pointed spears, causing the spinning to intensify.
This gesture drained her even more.
"Cut through!" With a weak gesture, the spinning disc moved, and the Forsaken warriors began screaming.
Be it the new arrivals, the old ones, or the blood-cursed ones, the spinning disc shredded through them, their blood-soaked screams erupting from their souls.
Camilla, just like Neomi, also vanished into the tower.
Next to move was Ingrid.
Kaizo’s plan was simple.
Since they couldn’t fight the Forsaken Clan head-on anymore, they would thin down their numbers by using their trump cards and hope things worked out in the end.
Ingrid floated just 300 meters away from the Forsaken warriors and clapped her palms together.
Then her eyes turned dark, almost as if she could see through the void.
Naturally, she could see through the void.
She slowly began to open her palm, causing a small black dot to appear between the palms that were opening.
"Are we safe?" Kaizo asked, looking at the Forsaken warriors who were charging toward Ingrid.
He didn’t panic, for he knew this was exactly what Ingrid was after.
Instinctively, he took a few steps back just in case.
One of the Spirit Lords got close and stabbed his sword forward.
However, just when his sword’s cold edge could touch Ingrid, she vanished, and in her place, the black dot she was holding appeared.
Then a voice came from the void, filling the entire space...
"Void Swallow!"
The small black dot instantly expanded and exuded a powerful suction force, swallowing everything within a 4km radius.
Naturally, that was a lot of Forsaken warriors.
The dot then shrank again, and Ingrid, with a pale face, appeared.
She took hold of it and shattered it in a firm grip.
From all over the battlefield, the void started tearing open, throwing out dead bodies.
When the last corpse fell, the Forsaken warriors realised they weren’t fighting an equal battle.
Fear gripped them.
But before they could process what was happening, a sweet yet dangerous voice entered their heads.
"Blossom, draw the lines.
Feisty, augment me."
Unity rose into the air, causing the atmosphere around her to shift dangerously.
Inside the painting, Blossom moved back and drew five lines, each merging at one end.
"Form," her sweet voice echoed from within the painting as the lines moved and merged with the five Heavenly Ascension stage experts trapped inside.
Feisty, on the other hand, merged with Unity’s body, causing her energy to rise severalfold.
Then she moved and entered the painting.
Inside the painting, Unity appeared in a real place, though on the outside, she looked as though she was painted into the painting
"Time for you to die." Perhaps it was a coincidence, but the words she spoke in the painting echoed to the outside, causing every last Forsaken warrior to pale.
Then it happened.
The lines that Blossom drew and linked to the five Forsaken Elders formed a bullseye, and that was where Unity aimed.
"This is going to hurt," Blossom muttered.
"Soul Extinguishing Arrow!"
The arrow flew and landed dead centre in the bullseye.
For a moment, nothing happened.
But then Unity coughed up blood and turned pale.
Blossom and Feisty also flickered and then vanished.
The painting unravelled, and six figures fell from the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 915: The Apocalypse (19)
paragraphs: Kaizo didn’t even have to say it, for Vari was already on the move when she saw Unity falling with the five Forsaken Elders. With her speed, she caught Unity before she could come down 6 meters to the ground.
She vanished, and a second later, she appeared alone.
The five forsaken elders slammed hard into the ground, showing they had died long before they even landed on the ground.
"Elaine, it is up to you two now."
Kaizo charged forward, and the rest followed.
The death of the five Heavenly Ascension stage experts was what he was waiting for, and now that they had died, nobody would be able to suppress them.
Unity sacrificed a lot for that one shot, and it paid off quite well.

They clashed again, and this time, even Kaizo knew they were out of their league. However, as someone with an unyielding personality, Kaizo didn’t back down, and neither did the rest of the legion and the harem.
However, a few minutes into it, many started retreating.
"Elaine!" Kaizo’s voice boomed as she slammed into the ground. His right arm broke from the force of the hammer that slammed into his body.
Elaine didn’t respond to the call. Instead, she remained standing with her eyes closed. A few seconds later, a tombstone rose from the ground and hovered behind her.
"Death Emergence."
She said the name of the skill, then began to chant some words that only she understood. However, the effect of those chants was immediately made known.

All over the battlefield, purple circles began to appear beneath the dead bodies that she had marked several minutes back. The moment the circle appeared, the body would vanish, and a tombstone would appear in its place.
As more bodies started vanishing and more tombstones kept appearing, Elaine started turning pale. However, she endured until she had 10,000 tombstones all over the battlefield.
By then, Elaine had turned pale white. However, she willed herself not to pass out until she unleashed the skill.
"Death Uprising."
On one side of the battlefield, a deadly bony hand burst from the ground and tore the earth open as a figure rose up. The aura around this bony man was far above the Core formation stage.
The figure who looked like he had been dead for years now appeared and lunged at the nearest forsaken warrior with a force so great, even the Spirit Kings were shaken.
This scenario repeated 9,999 times across the battlefield.
When the last dead body appeared, Elaine passed out and vanished from sight.
The Death Uprising drained her, but she had added some death warriors to her side.
However, even after all this, the forsaken warriors were just too powerful.

Just one Spirit Lord was already enough to handle hundreds of bugs before him. However, with people like Aetheris, Uncle Drake, Kaizo, and the Eternal Wrath Legion on the battlefield, they weren’t having an easy slaughter.
The forsaken Race went all out, and with more appearing through the door, the danger only seemed to be mounting by the second.
"Retreat!" Queen Jascia shouted, causing the half-elves still on the battlefield to move back.
"Thalirion, take them away," she said to her husband, who looked at her for a few seconds before he nodded and took his people away.

The moment her people were in a safe place, Queen Jascia unleashed her poison side, causing her strength to rise. "For my home world and the people I love, I will fight to the very end." She charged forward only to be pushed back.
However, she didn’t back down and charged forward again. This time, she started burning her life force, which gave her the power to push her opponent back.
On the other side of the battlefield, the various kings and queens made the same call as Queen Jascia. However, they themselves remained, knowing only that death awaited them.
Naturally, the only reason they hadn’t died yet was because Alina switched from offence to making sure every last teammate had several layers of protection.
She was basically keeping them alive.
Twenty minutes later, Alina was dreadfully tired, so the pressure was even more on her sisters and teammates.
"Veydris!"

Kaizo called out when a spear arrived before Lady Enzi, who had no way to evade. However, just before the spear could stab her, Veydris appeared from the void and took off the attacker’s head before vanishing back again.
Aside from Alina, Veydris and Irina were the other two keeping everyone alive.
"This is madness," Kaizo said as he pushed his bloodline power to the max, but he was barely keeping up with even the Spirit Sovereigns.
An hour later, the pressure was so much that half of the vampires were slaughtered along with the Tiger King and the Earth Dragon King.
They died bravely, but their sacrifice meant nothing when the battle was still at its peak and they were losing.
Surprisingly, one of the deadly weapons on the battlefield was in Lady Liora’s hands. She was like her codename, a silent angel of death claiming one life after the other.
Even when the pressure was mounting on them, she was among the few who kept killing like nothing had changed.
Meanwhile, inside the Forsaken World, the sky opened and a figure emerged, radiating an oppressive aura, the kind that caused the five Forsaken Elders to go down on their knees.
"Welcome, Forsaken Lord," they greeted.
The man, though handsome, wore a frown on his face as he saw nothing around him aside from the five people kneeling before him.
"What is going on?" he asked.
Deva looked up and answered in the best way she could, "My Lord, we ran into some unexpected complications, so I had to deploy all the Forsaken army to go exterminate the world that awaits you."
The frown on the man’s face deepened as he turned toward the door leading to Sonox.
"Let’s go end this farce. I don’t have much time and don’t intend to waste this avatar because you couldn’t subdue a mere Medium World."
Deva cursed her negligence, but she led the way.
On the battlefield, everyone was sweating profusely.
"Everyone, fall back! We have to seal the crack now!" Kaizo shouted, and with that command, everyone started moving back.
The pressure was too much for them, so the next best thing was to contain their enemies in the formation that had previously sealed the vampires.
That was Alina’s backup plan, and now it was their only way. Though they aren’t sure how long it will hold them, they knew it was the only way to at least retreat and figure something out.
Those closer to the crack managed to move through and appear in Sonox. However, just when the main strike force was about to reach it, a powerful voice spoke, and everyone felt their bodies give out.
"Where do you think you are going?"
Every last warrior retreating toward the crack and those holding back the advancing Forsaken army crashed to the ground, unable to even lift a finger.
Vexthra, who saw this, felt her face pale, and for a moment, hate and resentment appeared in her eyes, but Unity grabbed her hand before she could vanish back to the battlefield.
"Don’t, big sister. We still have Val," Unity said, and Vexthra turned to look at Val, whose eyes turned white, showing she had activated her trump card.
A powerful aura surged from her body, causing her to rise into the air.
She activated the Moon Goddess Descent, allowing her to free her teammates.
"Run!"
"Not on my watch." The man took one step and appeared before Val. His fist moved and landed a powerful punch to Val’s stomach, sending her flying.
However, before she could land on the ground, he appeared overhead and landed another punch to her ribcage.
Val coughed a mouthful of blood, but she didn’t vanish away like she should have. With her presence, more of her teammates managed to pass through the crack.
So she knew that if she could hold on for a few more seconds, her friends could reach safety. However, she underestimated the Forsaken Lord.
"Die." The man moved forward and kicked out this time, aiming for Val’s neck. The void beneath his foot cracked, revealing that he had put much more energy into that kick.

Val’s sister, who saw this, stopped retreating and lunged toward her, aiming to save her. However, they both knew it was futile. The man’s leg was already a few inches away, and they were meters away from her.
However, before the foot could land on her, a blood-red clawed hand tore through the void and grabbed hold of the leg.
"You dare lay hands on my wife!"

chapters.title: Chapter 916: The Apocalypse (20)
paragraphs: "You dare lay hands on my wife"
Suddenly, a slaughter aura descended on the battlefield right when the chilling words came from Kent’s mouth.
CRACK
The void cracked again, and Kent’s hand came out much longer this time, holding the leg of the man who attacked Val, while his other hand held Val’s bloodied figure.
Kent ejected a powerful energy into her body, causing Val to cough a mouthful of blood before passing out. Elsa arrived beside her and took her away.
CRACK
By the time the second crack sounded, the void was wide enough for Kent to come out. He walked through, still holding the man’s leg.

All this happened within seconds, but within those few seconds, the majority of the warriors, including even some of the vampires, managed to pass through the crack that was separating the Dead Region and Sonox.
Exactly five seconds after Kent caught the man’s leg, his other hand moved and severed it. However, the man didn’t seem to care, as he was suddenly forty meters away in the next second.
His cut-off leg regenerated, and a cold look appeared in his eyes.

"This person is not simple," he said to himself, looking on Kent with a scrutinising gaze. "However, I am a Root Immortal Avatar. Even if he was at the peak of the Death Stage, he wouldn’t be able to hold a candle against me."
The next second, however, his face contorted in shock. "A mere Avatar dares lay hands on my wife."*

Kent’s eyes turned deep red as faint red smoke rose from them. He extended his hand, and a sword appeared in his firm grip. In an instant, the aura around him turned from just blood to blood filled with sword energy.
"Gaia, do it," Kent commanded, and Gaia appeared a few meters from the Forsaken door and pointed at it.
In that instant, the Forsaken Lord’s expression turned ugly. "No, you don’t." He waved his hand, and two large hands moved and held the door that was closing in place.
Then, with another wave, two hundred Royal Vampires retreating from the battlefield were sucked back and hurled toward the door.
Gaia smirked and was about to wave her hand when Kent’s voice stopped her. "Allow them to pass." In an instant, the two hundred vampires passed through the door and appeared in the Forsaken world.
Naturally, the man should have been happy and even tried to escape, but the expression on his face was anything but happy.
Just now, Gaia could have prevented him from kidnapping the 200 vmapires, but Kent stopped her. This baffled him.
He turned to Kent, ignoring the door. "Why?"
The door closed the next second, but he didn’t panic. He can leave at any moment he wants.
Kent didn’t show any expression that said otherwise, but if one looked closely, they could sense a feeling—one that contained both pain, anger, and extreme hatred toward the Forsaken race.
"I don’t know why, but I have never hated anyone the way I hate you lot. So, I want you to use the vampires to open more doors, because that is the only way I will be able to reach you.
So until this hatred is satiated, I will never stop hunting your kind down. That is my promise."
Kent unleashed an aura that caused all the Forsaken warriors to feel primal fear. Most wanted to run, but the door closed.
And now, looking at Kent’s red eyes, they all felt their soul abandoning them.
"I will start with those of you here."
Gaia giggled and waved her hand, sealing the entire Dead Region. Kent moved, and the next second, the scent of blood filled the air.
"Kill him!" Lord Forsaken shouted, feeling his one-way transfer back to the Immortal World severed.
The five Forsaken Elders and the 102,000 Forsaken warriors on the battlefield charged at Kent, whose eyes were completely red.
"Primal Body Tempering Art..." Kent activated the technique that sent him into the Blood Enlightenment.
In an instant, a blood rune appeared on his forehead, and tiny blood essence from the warriors he was killing started entering it.
"Not enough," Kent shouted as he rose into the air and slashed his sword with both hands, causing a large arc of sword energy mixed with blood to flash out.
Hundreds were cut in half vertically. The blood essence flew and entered the Blood Rune, making him gain some more strength.
"You dare hurt my wife... my friends... Die for me." Kent was currently moving at a speed that even the Spirit Lords were finding difficult to track.
"Still too slow." Kent activated his Sword Clone Bodies, allowing 18 identical copies of him to appear in different parts of the battlefield.
But he didn’t stop there. He went ahead and activated the ’Flame Wheels’, causing his speed to surge past what even the Spirit Lords could track.
"Impossible." Deva, the strongest Forsaken Elder, felt her scalp go numb when she saw Kent flash past her, only for a hundred heads to roll to the ground the next second.
Lord Forsaken, who was trying his best to break the restriction Gaia lifted, turned and looked at the battlefield.
"Impossible."
With someone having the cultivation of an early-stage Root Immortal, he saw through Kent’s movement technique. However, what made him turn pale was the aura surrounding Kent.
It wasn’t that the Spirit Lords were weak. It was the fact that the moment they came within 2 meters of him, an aura that caused them to lose hold of themselves for a few seconds,
This causes them to become disturbed and feel a fear that dampens their will to keep fighting.
He saw it plainly, and that caused him to feel some fear toward Kent.
This only caused him to attack the seal even more. However, no matter how powerful his attacks were, the seal remained in place.
"Just give up and wait for my master to kill you." Gaia appeared 200 meters from Lord Forsaken and smiled at him.
"Little girl, open the seal before I make you."

Gaia giggled, "First of all, aside from my master, you have no power under or beyond the heavens to command me. Second, you are destined to die here today, so prepare. And lastly, you are rather weak for an Avatar of an Immortal."
Lord Forsaken shuddered, releasing a powerful aura that caused the space around him to warp. He lunged to attack Gaia, but he abandoned the attack halfway when he saw a smile appear on Gaia’s face.
He turned around and charged at Kent.
"As strong as my master is, he cannot face you and all those idiots at the same time, so relax for now." Gaia pointed her slender index finger forward, and Lord Forsaken froze mid-flight.
He could only watch as Kent slaughtered his people.
Kent had already killed over 50,000 Forsaken warriors. Two Forsaken Elders had already died, and one had lost an arm.

"Filthy bloods, you dare have the audacity to attack the world I live in... You must have a death wish." Kent’s voice was so cold that when it entered the ears of the Forsaken warriors, they couldn’t help but feel their bodies give up.
One hour later, only two Forsaken Elders remained, both injured and panting on the ground. Kent put away his sword and extended his hand. A golden flame appeared in his palm.
Deva and the other Forsaken Elder instantly turned pale when they saw the flame.

It was the fact that the moment they came within 2 meters of him, an aura that caused them to lose hold of themselves for a few seconds,
This causes them to become disturbed and feel a fear that dampens their will to keep fighting.
He saw it plainly, and that caused him to feel some fear toward Kent.
This only caused him to attack the seal even more.
However, no matter how powerful his attacks were, the seal remained in place.
"Just give up and wait for my master to kill you." Gaia appeared 200 meters from Lord Forsaken and smiled at him.
"Little girl, open the seal before I make you."
Gaia giggled, "First of all, aside from my master, you have no power under or beyond the heavens to command me.
Second, you are destined to die here today, so prepare.
And lastly, you are rather weak for an Avatar of an Immortal."
Lord Forsaken shuddered, releasing a powerful aura that caused the space around him to warp.
He lunged to attack Gaia, but he abandoned the attack halfway when he saw a smile appear on Gaia’s face.
He turned around and charged at Kent.
"As strong as my master is, he cannot face you and all those idiots at the same time, so relax for now." Gaia pointed her slender index finger forward, and Lord Forsaken froze mid-flight.
He could only watch as Kent slaughtered his people.
Kent had already killed over 50,000 Forsaken warriors.
Two Forsaken Elders had already died, and one had lost an arm.
"Filthy bloods, you dare have the audacity to attack the world I live in...
You must have a death wish." Kent’s voice was so cold that when it entered the ears of the Forsaken warriors, they couldn’t help but feel their bodies give up.
One hour later, only two Forsaken Elders remained, both injured and panting on the ground.
Kent put away his sword and extended his hand.
A golden flame appeared in his palm.
Deva and the other Forsaken Elder instantly turned pale when they saw the flame.

chapters.title: Chapter 917: I Eat Immortals For Breakfast (1)
paragraphs: The moment the two forsaken warriors saw the flame appear in Kent’s hand, they knew danger had found them.
Instinctively, their souls screamed at them to run, but their bodies couldn’t move. Kent made sure of that by driving dozens of Doom shards through their legs.
He further imbued the shards with Chaos energy by activating his bloodline, so every slight movement sends jolts of pain down to their souls.
Of course, there was nowhere to run to, so in a way, they were doomed, and they knew it. Kent turned and looked at Lord Forsaken, whose eyes were red and filled with anger.
"Don’t worry about him, master. Although I am not allowed to kill him, I can hold him for as long as you want. So get on with your business," Gaia said, and Kent smiled through his evil expression.
"Then I won’t be polite." Kent waved his hand, and the flame surrounded the first Forsaken Elder, whose scream filled the battlefield.

"Because I was in a hurry to kill you, I didn’t have the time to extract the true blood essence from the other three I killed. However, with you poor souls in my hands now, I will be sure to do it the right way before facing that idiot."
Kent formed a hand seal, and the flame intensified, causing the screaming coming from the Forsaken Elder to turn hoarse.
"Life is just this way. You don’t always get the good end of the stick," Kent said as he formed more seals.
"Had I been a second late, my wife would have died. That would have been bad. However, I managed to arrive on time, and thus, we are here now.
The reason why I am telling you this is for you to know the kind of fate that awaits your people." Kent turned sideways and looked at Lord Forsaken.
"I know your real body can hear what I am saying, so listen well. I am someone who values happiness above all else. I don’t hate, for hatred is for those who have no other choice.
But for someone to hate you means they want you gone, and thus hate is the strongest evil intent a person can ever have.
So, for me to hate you, know that there is no way I will let you go scot-free. I will follow up on this and will continue hunting for your kind for generations to come.
So take in this moment. Let it imprint on your mind and do well to remember, for this is the fate that awaits you when I get my hands on you."

The flame intensified, and the scream of the Forsaken Elder increased even more. Eventually, he stopped screaming. A few seconds later, his body was consumed by the flame. The only thing that remained was a pill-sized blood essence.
Kent waved his hand, and the blood essence floated and entered his forehead.
For a second, nothing happened. However, a few seconds later, a powerful pressure crashed down on Deva, who immediately started coughing blood.
The aura around Kent intensified several-fold. "That is more like it," Kent smiled, looking at Deva, whose face was pale.
Lord Forsaken held an even paler look on his face.
What Kent had just done defied common sense.

From common sense, when absorbing the purest form of one’s blood essence, they must at least prepare other counter treasures that they will need to counter the overwhelming and chaotic energy of the blood essence.
However, Kent just absorbed it, and he appeared fine. It was almost as if he looked disappointed that the essence inside the blood he had just absorbed wasn’t enough.
If that isn’t scary to the point that even an Immortal turned pale, then scary doesn’t exist.
After adjusting to the newfound strength, Kent looked coldly at Deva, and the flame surrounded her. Her screams filled the place.

Kent specifically knew that when it came to a fair battle in his current element, he had the means to face an average Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator, one from a Legacy High world and maybe a Great High world.
So he went ahead and let the flame consume Deva, who happened to be a level 5 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator. This meant her blood essence would be much stronger than the level 3 he had refined.
Inside the tower, Vexthra and the ladies were watching Kent on a projected screen.
"He has become much stronger now," Vexthra muttered, a glint flashing across her eyes.
"But can he kill that man?" Mara asked, and her sisters nodded in agreement. They all couldn’t help wondering the same thing.
"He wouldn’t have sealed the place if he wasn’t sure he would be able to kill him. Also, the man is a mere Avatar, though he has a cultivation base of an Early Stage Root Immortal."

The ladies sucked in a cold breath, knowing there was nothing they could do in this case to help him. However, on the battlefield, there was one person still hovering in the air, and that person was Uncle Drake.
He had a crazy look in his eyes, and a battle intent that screamed danger could be seen in them. However, despite sticking around, he knew he wouldn’t be able to help Kent.
"I need to go to that place I saw in my dreams. If I want to unlock my true self, I must go there," he muttered, but he remained just at the entrance of the crack leading to Sonox.
After 30 minutes, Kent was done refining the last Forsaken Elder. The golden essence blood entered his forehead, causing Kent to smile cheerfully.
He turned and looked at Lord Forsaken. "Time for you to die."
The moment Kent said that, Gaia freed Lord Forsaken, allowing him to dash at Kent in a rather powerful charge. Kent had no time to dodge, so he crossed his sword across his chest and took the punch.
He was pushed back just 4 meters, causing Lord Forsaken to frown.
Kent sneered. "What?" He smiled. "You think I would take such a punch without knowing I can handle it?"
Lord Forsaken didn’t answer but moved again, this time causing the very ground to crack, creating a 2-meter-wide crater.
However, Kent merely smiled as the Soul Map expanded, allowing him to see the deception in the attack.
Kent moved back and jumped to his left just in time to evade a pointed metallic shard that came for his heart.
’A metal cultivator, huh?’ Kent’s heart beat wildly as he evaded even more attacks from the same metallic shards. However, the faster or quicker he moved, the faster the shards came at him.
’He is calculating my moves based on when and how I make them.’ Kent twisted his body and used the blade of his sword to deflect a much more powerful form of the shard.
’Interesting. Although he doesn’t seem to have sword gaze, he is still able to calculate and adapt even faster than I with sword gaze.’ The light in Kent’s eyes didn’t dim.
If anything, knowing he was completely outclassed and outmatched, the zeal to battle this Lord Forsaken had become even more intense.
A metallic shard stabbed at Kent, but he moved his body just fast enough to evade the shard, only for a powerful kick from Lord Forsaken to send him flying back.
Kent landed on the ground, but he wasn’t hurt in any way. Before he could move, the ground twisted, and his legs were encased in a thick layer of sand.
The next second, a powerful fist arrived in front of him.
’Impressive,’ Kent smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 918: I Eat Immortals For Breakfast (2)
paragraphs: From the moment the first blow landed on Kent’s body, he knew he was outmatched.

However, while he could merely ask Gaia to lock Lord Forsaken down and seal the place so that later, when he had the required strength, he would come back to face him, Kent’s nature immediately rejected the idea of retreating.
If anything, he felt like going into a life-and-death battle.
So he stayed, and for the 40 seconds they fought, he was outmatched in both speed and attack power.
However, that was the main reason Kent chose to fight in the first place.
When he fought his perfect clone back in the sect, it was merely a battle where they were all using the same skills and techniques.
He lost in the end, but he didn’t feel that danger, knowing the enemy would be making a move he had never seen or used before.
That adrenaline, the rush in knowing the next second he would be stabbed through the heart or beheaded, that danger, he wanted to feel it, and thus Kent was locked in this battle.
However, he never expected Lord Forsaken to be this decisive.
His legs were rooted in place, and the fist carrying the strength of an early-stage Root Immortal arrived before his eyes.
Naturally, if that fist landed, Kent’s head would explode, and he would die.
However, killing him wasn’t something that could be achieved that easily.
The moment the fist arrived, Kent activated the Clone Bodies and swapped places with one of the clones that appeared 3 meters behind Lord Forsaken.
Even he couldn’t have predicted Kent would make such a move. However, he did, and right when the fist landed on the clone’s face, a thin reddish-gold sword arc flashed out from behind him.
Lord Forsaken twisted his body quickly and made a wide swing with his hand in an attempt to block the sword arc that he couldn’t evade.
However, before his hand could reach the sword arc, a powerful aura locked on his body, causing him to turn to his left.
Kent appeared on his left with a stabbing attack. Naturally, Lord Forsaken was supposed to ignore one attack and defend the one coming for his life.
However, both attacks were coming for his life, so he used his strength to move and kick forward, leaving only one leg on the ground.
He was using one of his legs to defend against the stabbing and his hand for the sword arc.
SLASH
A painful feeling appeared on his face as his body dropped by a foot.
Kent appeared 30 meters away with a grin on his face.
"Not to brag, but when it comes to close combat, you can’t contend with me." He watched as Lord Forsaken regenerated his leg.
’Kent, he is an Avatar with a cultivation base of Early Stage Root Immortal. This means he can’t use his immortal aura to power his attacks.
It also means that using active skills will become a headache for him.

So the more you injure him, the weaker he will become. Naturally, he also cannot die, knowing his real body will suffer a great blow wherever he is. So he wouldn’t use powerful active skills and techniques.
However, if he becomes desperate, he will go all out, and that will be bad for you. So be careful.
[Thank you, my goddess.]
Kent let a smile appear on his face, but the next second, he frowned and looked to his left.
"Immortals are indeed powerful. In my current form, I am afraid I will be throwing my life away if I were to face them in combat."

Kent moved to his left, evading a flying sword that Lord Forsaken picked from the ground. He used his mind to control it, and soon, more swords started flying out at Kent, making the dragon start to get cornered.

"So much for learning his moves using my sword gaze." Kent activated the flame wheels and started speeding through the many swords flying at him. Soon, over ten thousand swords appeared in the air and were quickly raining down on him.
Kent was moving like a blur, but even so, he was sustaining injuries at a rapid pace.
However, if one looked closely, they would see that the cuts landing on Kent’s body were being healed the next second, only for another cut to appear.
But no matter how many times the swords cut him, Kent didn’t slow down. If anything, his speed continued to increase at an unprecedented rate.
⟦The master’s speed has already surpassed that of a Spirit Emperor in Supreme High Worlds at their peak⟧
Kent smiled as he kept moving even faster.
He had instructed the tower to inform him when he surpassed the speed a peak Spirit Emperor stage expert in a supreme High world would have.
He wanted to know how much power he had attained and how he compared to the experts in the Supreme High World.
He knew his strength had already surpassed them in strength, and the only thing he lacked was speed.
’Tower, say I were to activate all 1000 flame veins, can my body withstand the speed?’
⟦The master has attained Nirvana, and so, unless the master were to hit an unbreakable wall while moving, his body can handle the speed⟧
Kent smiled, feeling the joke in the tower’s words.
’In that case, I have to let this immortal experience my top speed before I send him on his way.’
Kent activated his flame veins 100 at a time, causing his speed to surge. In an instant, his movement went up several folds compared to when he was using his own speed.

’That’s more like it, ’ he smiled and started all the more Flame Veins to it. After he attained the Nirvana body, the nine Nirvana flames that reforged his body helped him form 1000 flame veins. This is the first time he is using them.
Whenever he activated them, his speed surged at least threefold.
By the time 400 flame veins were activated, Lord Forsaken had already started to have a hard time tracking him.

It wasn’t just because he was weak—it was more that he was using too much energy to control the swords. In reality, he hadn’t prepared before coming because he expected his clan to have Sonox cleared by the time he arrived.
However, aside from the 10% immortal energy he had left in his body, the rest had been used to open the forbidden greater teleporter he relied on to get to the Forsaken World.
He had also used 4% of the remaining 10% to try to open the restriction Gaia had raised. So, in a way, he had wasted all his energy in pointless endeavours before clashing with Kent.
Four more were used to lift and control the swords in order to attack Kent.
Now, with only 2% of his energy left, he knew Kent had to die. However, what greeted him was speed beyond his imagination.
But Kent didn’t stop at just 400. He went ahead and gradually activated all 1,000 of his flame veins. The moment all were activated, Kent saw the world slow down.
He could see it—Lord Forsaken was moving sluggishly. It was almost like he couldn’t see Kent at all.
’Hey Tower, say I inject the flames of Nirvana into his core, how bad would it get for his true body currently in the immortal realm?’ Kent first asked the expert.
[You should ask the goddess this question, master. I am afraid even I don’t know.]
Kent raised his brow, and an evil smile appeared on his face.
’Why don’t we find out the answer together?’ Kent moved and appeared behind Lord Forsaken, gently tapping him on the shoulder.

Inside the tower, the ladies were, in a strange way, able to track Kent’s speed. So when Vexthra saw the blue flame appear in Kent’s hands, her face paled, and instinctively she broke into a cold sweat that caught her sisters off guard.
