chapters.title: Chapter 938: The Faceless Assassin
paragraphs: The Faceless Art can be regarded as one of the most complex and terrifying techniques in the universe.
Nobody knew its origin—only that one day, out of nowhere, a figure emerged who could take on the appearance of those he killed.
However, it was not merely about stealing appearances.
The core of the Faceless Art ran much deeper.

If it were only about imitating the appearance of those he killed, then many others could have been called faceless assassins. Countless disguise techniques exist that can mimic anyone’s appearance, even down to their birthmarks.
The Faceless Art, however, was far more complex than that.
The one whose appearance was taken would, in a sense, have their entire life seized by the Faceless assassin.
This meant their memories, mannerisms, curses, cultivation base, desires, and aversions—everything about them—would be copied.
Naturally, there was no other technique in existence besides the Faceless Art that allowed someone to assume both the appearance and the cultivation base of the one they killed.

There was simply none. Yet with the Faceless Art, everything could be replicated, even the soul imprints. It was a terrifying technique that, if not carefully used, could cause user to forget their own identity.
Living others’ lives for too long could make you forget your own.
Kent sat in a lotus posture inside the inn he had booked. His eyes were closed, his body calm, and the only sound in the room was the strange chant that flowed from his lips.
Mysterious symbols appeared on his body as he continued to chant.
The more he recited those words, the more symbols surfaced.
Kent was so deeply absorbed in his cultivation that he did not even realise when midnight arrived. Fortunately, a few minutes later, his eyes slowly opened.
A faint smile appeared on his face as he stood up. "I am ready."
The Soul Map had expanded to its full capacity. The eighty-thousand-kilometre radius was now open to him, allowing him to observe everything within its scope.

At that moment, his gaze was fixed on fourteen individuals whose identities he intended to seize. After eliminating them, he would use their stolen identities to take the lady from the auction away and back to her world.
Well, that was his initial plan.

"The plan is to kill those below Level Six Spirit Lord. I can’t go all out in my assassin form, and since I am still considered an amateur assassin, cutting my coat too large would only bring trouble."
Kent walked to the window, silently evaluating the assassination-type skills and techniques currently at his disposal.
"I have Shadow Smoke, which allows me to transform into smoke. Though it consumes an immense amount of energy, it will secure my escape if things go wrong.
Then there is Bone Cutter, which amplifies my attacks six hundredfold. As long as I can get within a meter of my target, I will be able to end them with a single strike.
Fortunately, the Shadow Walker skill will let me traverse through shadows quickly. Then with Shadow Aura, I can remain hidden to a certain extent—at least until the moment I strike."

These were the only skills he possessed as an assassin, thanks to Faceless, his incarnation. Kent did not have much confidence in his ability to pull all this off, so he borrowed a skill from Jest, another of his past incarnations.
The skill is called Multiple Blade.
It is a sword skill that allows him to strike once, yet the attack appears to be double. This illusion could easily confuse his enemy.
He also planned to use the Clone Bodies to move quickly, in case a single strike was not enough to deliver a killing blow.
"Here we go."
[First Target]
One of the fourteen individuals Kent intended to kill was currently hidden inside an abandoned building near one of the teleportation gates, roughly twenty thousand kilometres from the auction house.
He was a Level Four Spirit Lord.
His mission was to scan every last person entering the teleportation gate. Knowing that the lady who had bought the Soul Spirit would attempt a swift escape, they had stationed him there.
He was one of the many operatives deployed by the Vice Leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace. With watchers positioned everywhere, he felt confident that they would eventually catch her.
The man sat in silence, his senses stretched outward, carefully scanning for any disturbance.
Naturally, he was supposed to notice the slightest ripple in his surroundings. Yet, as Kent drew near, he remained oblivious.
This was all thanks to the Shadow Aura Kent had activated. It made him blend seamlessly into the darkness, like a phantom. His steps were soundless, his presence erased.
From the small memories Kent had witnessed of his past life as the Faceless Assassin, he understood one principle clearly: when it came to the Art of Assassination, impatience was fatal.
From these memories, Kent saw how Faceless would lie in wait for months just to execute a single strike.
Kent copied him, and so he wasn’t in a rush. He knew that killing this one man would make the rest of his task far easier.
The rule was simple: kill one, assume their life, and then use their relationships and familiarity to eliminate the others with ease.
"It has already been ten hours since the auction. When will that woman finally appear?" the man muttered, his sharp gaze fixed on the teleportation gate.
He pulled out a communication crystal and infused his energy into it. "Yan, what is the update on your end?"
Thirty thousand kilometres away, a young man retrieved his own crystal and responded, "Nothing yet, Brother Yuan."

Yuan—the man Kent was approaching—took in a cold breath. "Keep searching. The lord has already sent word to the sect. Reinforcements will arrive by morning. By then, she will no longer be able to hide."
"Alright, Brother Yuan. But what if that old woman comes for her daughter?"
"That is not for us to concern ourselves with. The Vice leader already has plans to deal with her. Focus on your surveillance."
After putting away the communication crystal, Yuan exhaled deeply, then pulled out a strip of dried spirit beast meat and bit into it, tearing a chunk off.
He was about to chew when his sixth sense suddenly screamed at him. Before he could even turn, a hand clamped over his mouth, and a cold voice whispered into his ear:
"Sleep tight."
Those were the last words he ever heard before everything turned dark.
His severed head rolled across the floor as Kent calmly sheathed his dagger.
A faint smile touched his lips. "Looks like I still got it."
With a gentle laugh, he looted the body and then got to work.
He sat cross-legged once more and resumed chanting. Strange symbols reappeared across his body, but this time they also manifested on Yuan’s corpse.
After a few minutes, the glowing symbols detached from the dead man and flew into Kent’s body. The moment the last one merged with Kent’s body, a message appeared before his eyes.
⟦Congratulations. You have successfully added a Face to your Collection⟧
⟦Current Faces: 001/999⟧
↠ Yuan Li
Kent opened his eyes and walked toward the body. With a flick of his hand, flames erupted and consumed the corpse until nothing remained.
He exhales for a few moments before activating the Faceless Art. His body began to shift.
His hair changed first, followed by his face, then his height and skin tone.
In mere moments, Kent had fully taken on the appearance of Yuan Li.
"We are in business," he said. His voice, expression, and posture were no longer his own, but belonged entirely to the newly deceased and burnt Yuan Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 939: Change of Plans
paragraphs: "Big Brother Yuan, is everything okay?" asked a young man clad in a green robe, similar to the one Yuan was wearing.
He was among those tasked with keeping a lookout for any sighting of Lady Azela, the woman who had purchased the Tier 18 Forsaken Soul Spirit.
Yuan smiled with a welcoming expression that immediately caused the young man to lower his guard.
"Everything is alright. The leader asked me to personally come around and ensure you are all at your posts."
The young man also smiled. "I haven’t sensed anything unusual from the inns and hotels within a 14,000-kilometre radius."
As a Level 3 Spirit Lord, seeing 14,000 kilometres was well within his capacity.
Yuan nodded. "I will be sure to let the leader know of your dedication."
Yuan then turned to leave. Seeing this, the young man also turned around and resumed paying attention to his surroundings, focusing on the inns and restaurants he had chosen.
A second later, however, he heard two words before his vision went dark—
"Sleep tight."
Kent, who was now in the form of Yuan, sighed as he looked at the headless body on the ground.
There was no remorse on his face, no trace of hesitation, nothing to suggest that he regretted assassinating someone who was merely fulfilling his duty as a member of the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
To Kent, this was necessary to achieve his ultimate goal of obtaining the armour.
If he had the money, he would have simply bought it at the auction. However, he knew that would have placed him in direct conflict with the Vice Leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
In a way, he was destined to clash with these poor souls. Even if he had purchased the armour, they would have eventually come after him, which would have forced him to kill them anyway.
"It isn’t as if they are angels," Kent muttered. "They chose to go against the Pyris Pill Alliance, all while secretly dealing with other alliances. In a way, I’m merely cleaning house."
With that, Kent sat down and began to chant.
A few minutes later, he had taken on another Face.
"This one was much faster than the first," Kent noted, realising that the process of seizing another’s identity became easier when their cultivation base was lower.
"This is the second Face I have harvested. If I continue like this for too long, they are bound to notice." Only now did Kent fully recognise the flaw in his plan.
The more he killed, the sooner they would realise something was wrong. They were bound to attempt communication, and if no response came, they would eventually come to investigate.
He already had the Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator overseeing the operation sealed within his Soul Map. He also has other people from different factions captured within his coverage.
However, just as he finished taking the new face, he sensed the arrival of new people.
"Looks like I have to hurry."
Disguised in Yuan Li’s face, Kent left. He went to three more targets, and after swiftly eliminating them, he chose to retreat when he noticed someone new arriving.
Among the newcomers were three Heavenly Ascension experts, whose cultivation levels were at the sixth, seventh, and eighth levels.
But what made Kent retreat was not them—it was another figure among them, whose aura was so faint that one might have mistaken him for a mortal.
Yet with his Soul Map spanning an 80,000-kilometre radius, Kent pierced through his aura. With his Enchanted Eyes, he saw the man’s true cultivation.
"True Peak... this person is at the very pinnacle of the Heavenly Ascension stage, with a foundation so solid that even I nearly failed to see through him."
"I can’t continue the hunt anymore if I don’t want to expose myself.
Without hesitation, Kent moved with lightning speed, heading straight toward the inn Lady Azela had rented.

On the way, he paused and used two hours to handle some business that he knew would bear fruit soon. After that was done, he turned back to his real self and started heading in Lady Azela’s direction.
Inside the room, Lady Azela sat with an orb in her hand.
A face flickered across its surface. "Mother," she whispered, her expression tense, "I think that old monster is here. Just now, I sensed a dangerous presence entering Central City from the north."
The face on the orb frowned. "If he is there, then it means they already knew I was coming." A contemplative expression appeared on the woman’s face.
"This is an ambush. If I come, they will attack, and there is no guarantee I can protect you."
Lady Azela sighed and was about to speak when Kent’s voice suddenly echoed in her mind. "Tell your mother not to worry. I will bring you to her in one piece."
Lady Azela frowned. Her mother noticed the shift in her expression and asked, "What is wrong, Azela?"
Azela considered lying, but Kent’s voice once again resounded in her head. "Tell her."
"It is the person who sold the Soul Spirit," Azela finally said. "He told me you shouldn’t come because he will bring it to you."
"Can he be trusted?" the woman in the orb asked, her tone calm but sharp.
"I don’t know," Azela admitted, "but he seems to have the means to see through every restriction and even managed to help me escape the auction house unharmed."
"If I were to come, the situation would escalate. But if this person can truly bring you out of the city and off-world safely, then I will make sure to reward him greatly."
Kent’s voice netered Lady Azela’s head once more, tinged with amusement. "Tell your mother I love rewards."
Lady Azela’s frown deepened, but she still repeated his words. A few seconds later, the connection with the orb faded, and she carefully put it away.
"Come down to the restaurant opposite your inn. I am seated behind table five."
She clenched her fists lightly.

She did not know how any of this was possible, but she could not help wondering what kind of existence Kent truly was. To see through formations and restrictions so effortlessly, he had to be a terrifying powerhouse.
Restoring her disguise, she left her room, descended the stairs, and crossed the street to the restaurant. Though her heart was unsettled, her expression remained calm and respectful.
However, the moment she stepped inside and turned toward table five, she froze. What she saw stunned her.
A handsome young man sat there, waving at her with a piece of roasted meat in his hand. She almost tripped in shock.
Kent’s smile was like the morning sun reflecting off a steaming sea.
His Core Formation cultivation base was laid bare for all to sense, making the scene even more unbelievable.
She hadn’t expected such a sight to greet her.
"Don’t just stand there. I’ve already ordered a plate for you," Kent’s voice slipped directly into her mind.
Forcing herself to remain composed, Lady Azela approached and took a seat across from him.

"I know what you’re thinking," Kent said, a playful smile tugging at his lips. "How in the heavens is a Core Formation brat able to pierce through formations and even plan to smuggle you out of this city and off-world?"
He chuckled lightly. "The answer is simple. I’m awesome."
Lady Azela sighed inwardly and was about to stand and walk away when Kent activated the Soul Map’s sharing function.
His voice entered her mind.
"Right now, all entrances and teleportation gates are being watched. No matter how many disguises you put on, no matter how strong you are, you won’t escape."
Lady Azela stiffened, her eyes widening as she took in the sight revealed within the Soul Map.
"As I said," Kent continued calmly, "I will bring you out of the city and off-world. But first, sit down, enjoy this meal with me, and let’s have a pleasant conversation..."

sentences.text: "Big Brother Yuan, is everything okay?" asked a young man clad in a green robe, similar to the one Yuan was wearing.
He was among those tasked with keeping a lookout for any sighting of Lady Azela, the woman who had purchased the Tier 18 Forsaken Soul Spirit.
Yuan smiled with a welcoming expression that immediately caused the young man to lower his guard.
"Everything is alright.
The leader asked me to personally come around and ensure you are all at your posts."
The young man also smiled.
"I haven’t sensed anything unusual from the inns and hotels within a 14,000-kilometre radius."
As a Level 3 Spirit Lord, seeing 14,000 kilometres was well within his capacity.
Yuan nodded.
"I will be sure to let the leader know of your dedication."
Yuan then turned to leave.
Seeing this, the young man also turned around and resumed paying attention to his surroundings, focusing on the inns and restaurants he had chosen.
A second later, however, he heard two words before his vision went dark—
"Sleep tight."
Kent, who was now in the form of Yuan, sighed as he looked at the headless body on the ground.
There was no remorse on his face, no trace of hesitation, nothing to suggest that he regretted assassinating someone who was merely fulfilling his duty as a member of the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
To Kent, this was necessary to achieve his ultimate goal of obtaining the armour.
If he had the money, he would have simply bought it at the auction.
However, he knew that would have placed him in direct conflict with the Vice Leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
In a way, he was destined to clash with these poor souls.
Even if he had purchased the armour, they would have eventually come after him, which would have forced him to kill them anyway.
"It isn’t as if they are angels," Kent muttered.
"They chose to go against the Pyris Pill Alliance, all while secretly dealing with other alliances.
In a way, I’m merely cleaning house."
With that, Kent sat down and began to chant.
A few minutes later, he had taken on another Face.
"This one was much faster than the first," Kent noted, realising that the process of seizing another’s identity became easier when their cultivation base was lower.
"This is the second Face I have harvested.
If I continue like this for too long, they are bound to notice." Only now did Kent fully recognise the flaw in his plan.
The more he killed, the sooner they would realise something was wrong.
They were bound to attempt communication, and if no response came, they would eventually come to investigate.
He already had the Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator overseeing the operation sealed within his Soul Map.
He also has other people from different factions captured within his coverage.
However, just as he finished taking the new face, he sensed the arrival of new people.
"Looks like I have to hurry."
Disguised in Yuan Li’s face, Kent left.
He went to three more targets, and after swiftly eliminating them, he chose to retreat when he noticed someone new arriving.
Among the newcomers were three Heavenly Ascension experts, whose cultivation levels were at the sixth, seventh, and eighth levels.
But what made Kent retreat was not them—it was another figure among them, whose aura was so faint that one might have mistaken him for a mortal.
Yet with his Soul Map spanning an 80,000-kilometre radius, Kent pierced through his aura.
With his Enchanted Eyes, he saw the man’s true cultivation.
"True Peak... this person is at the very pinnacle of the Heavenly Ascension stage, with a foundation so solid that even I nearly failed to see through him."
"I can’t continue the hunt anymore if I don’t want to expose myself.
Without hesitation, Kent moved with lightning speed, heading straight toward the inn Lady Azela had rented.
On the way, he paused and used two hours to handle some business that he knew would bear fruit soon.
After that was done, he turned back to his real self and started heading in Lady Azela’s direction.
Inside the room, Lady Azela sat with an orb in her hand.
A face flickered across its surface.
"Mother," she whispered, her expression tense, "I think that old monster is here.
Just now, I sensed a dangerous presence entering Central City from the north."
The face on the orb frowned.
"If he is there, then it means they already knew I was coming." A contemplative expression appeared on the woman’s face.
"This is an ambush.
If I come, they will attack, and there is no guarantee I can protect you."
Lady Azela sighed and was about to speak when Kent’s voice suddenly echoed in her mind.
"Tell your mother not to worry.
I will bring you to her in one piece."
Lady Azela frowned.
Her mother noticed the shift in her expression and asked, "What is wrong, Azela?"
Azela considered lying, but Kent’s voice once again resounded in her head.
"Tell her."
"It is the person who sold the Soul Spirit," Azela finally said.
"He told me you shouldn’t come because he will bring it to you."
"Can he be trusted?" the woman in the orb asked, her tone calm but sharp.
"I don’t know," Azela admitted, "but he seems to have the means to see through every restriction and even managed to help me escape the auction house unharmed."
"If I were to come, the situation would escalate.
But if this person can truly bring you out of the city and off-world safely, then I will make sure to reward him greatly."
Kent’s voice netered Lady Azela’s head once more, tinged with amusement.
"Tell your mother I love rewards."
Lady Azela’s frown deepened, but she still repeated his words.
A few seconds later, the connection with the orb faded, and she carefully put it away.
"Come down to the restaurant opposite your inn.
I am seated behind table five."
She clenched her fists lightly.
She did not know how any of this was possible, but she could not help wondering what kind of existence Kent truly was.
To see through formations and restrictions so effortlessly, he had to be a terrifying powerhouse.
Restoring her disguise, she left her room, descended the stairs, and crossed the street to the restaurant.
Though her heart was unsettled, her expression remained calm and respectful.
However, the moment she stepped inside and turned toward table five, she froze.
What she saw stunned her.
A handsome young man sat there, waving at her with a piece of roasted meat in his hand.
She almost tripped in shock.
Kent’s smile was like the morning sun reflecting off a steaming sea.
His Core Formation cultivation base was laid bare for all to sense, making the scene even more unbelievable.
She hadn’t expected such a sight to greet her.
"Don’t just stand there.
I’ve already ordered a plate for you," Kent’s voice slipped directly into her mind.
Forcing herself to remain composed, Lady Azela approached and took a seat across from him.

I’m awesome."

No matter how many disguises you put on, no matter how strong you are, you won’t escape."
Lady Azela stiffened, her eyes widening as she took in the sight revealed within the Soul Map.
"As I said," Kent continued calmly, "I will bring you out of the city and off-world.
But first, sit down, enjoy this meal with me, and let’s have a pleasant conversation..."

chapters.title: Chapter 940: The Perfect Plan
paragraphs: In the many shocking things Lady Azela had anticipated, sitting across from a mere Core Formation brat who claimed he could save her was the last thing she expected.
However, no matter how many times she wished this situation were merely a dream, Kent never seemed to vanish from her sight, making her impossible dream a stark reality.
"If you keep staring at me like that, people are going to think I have kidnapped you, and that wouldn’t be pleasant for us—especially you," Kent said, chewing on a chunk of meat.
Lady Azela neither touched her food nor spoke a word. She simply gazed at the scene before her eyes, while simultaneously observing the one unfolding within the Soul Map.
The entire 80,000-kilometre radius lay bare before her vision. Even with her peak Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivation, her sensing range had never been this vast.
But even if she could normally stretch her senses so far, she would never be able to pierce through formations in the way the Soul Map allowed her to.

At the far end of the Central Region, she saw the Old Monster from the Blue Flame Pill Palace seated with three others, all waiting for news of her whereabouts while also keeping their senses spread out.
"Do you want to hear what they’re saying?" Kent asked.
She silently nodded.
Although the voice aspect of the soul map consumed more soul essence, Kent possessed more than enough soul essence to spare.
With a thought, he triggered the hearing function and restricted it to the old man and the three other heavenly ascension cultivators.
Their whispers spilt into Lady Azela’s ears.
"The Vice Leader has sent the word. The elders have already made their way to Planet Nictus and surrounded the sect.
If she somehow manages to sneak out of here before we arrive, they will seize her before she gets within ten thousand miles of her sect.

The Vice Leader himself is also lying in wait for the Old Witch to emerge from the sect. He brought with him the Soul Extinguishing Pill. Even if he cannot contend with her, that pill will end her for sure."
Lady Azela trembled in her seat, and even Kent’s brows furrowed when they heard the mention of a Soul Extinguishing Pill.
As an alchemist with profound knowledge of countless pills, Kent knew well that the Soul Extinguishing Pill is one of the deadliest combat-type pills in existence.

All one had to do was channel their energy into it and throw it at their target. Though the user would sustain soul damage, it was nothing compared to the devastation awaiting the one struck by the pill.
In Kent’s eyes, using such a despicable method to kill an enemy was nothing short of barbaric.
If struck by the Soul Extinguishing Pill, your soul will first split in half, then a painful and piercing torture will follow, one that will ensure you will continue to scream even after you die.
It is the worst kind of pill an alchemist wouldn’t ever dare dream of concocting if they have a shred of sanity in them.
The old man nodded, a faint smile tugging at his lips.
"Vince is always decisive. That is one of the many reasons I made him my vice. If he manages to take down both the mother and the daughter at once, I will step down and make him the leader."
A grim smile crept onto Kent’s face.
"I must kill him before returning home... However, first, I will kill his vice and wear his face to finish the job," he muttered, his words dulling the fury that was burning in Lady Azela’s eyes.
"You make it sound as if killing a Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivator is simple," she said, gazing at Kent with an unreadable expression.
"Who said it is simple?" Kent replied coolly. "It is not. But it is not impossible either. And since he is already marked for death, I will make it happen."
Lady Azela didn’t say a word. She could tell from the expression on Kent’s face that he was deadly serious.

If she had only just met him, she might have doubted his resolve, but after witnessing what he was capable of, she began to think that perhaps the brat sitting across from her wasn’t so simple after all.
Kent suddenly lost his appetite. He raised his hand and snapped his fingers, instantly sealing the space around them.
"First, we have to leave this city and this planet. However, we won’t be going to your planet right away."
Her brows furrowed. "Where would we be going then, and why can’t we go to my world? My mother’s life is in danger."
"So long as she remains within the sect, I’m certain she will be safe."
"Yes, she will be safe. But she is someone who worries about my safety. If I remain away for too long, she will start to panic." A distant look flickered in Lady Azela’s eyes.
Kent chuckled softly. "It’s cute, really. At your age, and she still worries so much about you, what an amusing mother-daughter relationship." Kent laughed.
"Don’t worry, we’ll head to Planet Aerithyne first. I have some business there, but it won’t take more than a day. After that, we’ll head straight to your world."
Her expression calmed down a bit. She studied Kent for a few minutes and said.
"I don’t know if you know, but with the sudden appearance of a Pill Monarch and the backing of a Pill Sovereign, the Blue Flame Pill Palace is already moving to overthrow the Pyris Pill Alliance.
Their influence is vast and terrifying. Leaving this city under my disguise is nearly impossible—especially with Lord Poe around."
Kent scoffed. "Leaving this city is the easiest part. Killing the one named Vince, who possesses the Soul Extinguishing Pill, is the real challenge."

Though Kent was immune to soul attacks, he knew the Soul Extinguishing Pill was no mere pill he could take for granted. It contained a potent form of resentment capable of burning a soul itself, leaving its victim begging for death.
He had no intention of testing its effects on himself.
Lady Azela steadied her breath, though her calm gaze was fixed on Kent. "Do you have a plan?"
"Of course I do," Kent replied, his voice steady, "I have the perfect plan."
Leaning forward, he channelled his soul energy into his right index finger and drew a glowing symbol in the air.
As soon as it formed, he pressed it against Lady Azela’s forehead. In an instant, she felt her cultivation plummet from the peak of Heavenly Ascension down to level 5 Spirit King.
Her eyes widened in shock. "What did you do to me?" she asked in a panicked tone

"Simple," Kent said calmly. "I temporarily suppressed your cultivation to the Spirit King stage. Even if they test you, it will register as nothing more than that. Unfortunately, until I remove the seal, you’ll only be able to use the strength of a Spirit King."
Her frown deepened. "What about my disguise? It is not absolute."

Kent smirked again. He tapped her forehead once more, sending a wave of soul energy into her body. It formed into a layer of skin that instantly trapped Lady Azela in her current disguised appearance.
"All done. With this, we can leave the city and head directly to Planet Aerithyne."
Lady Azela stared at him in silence for a long while, her expression unreadable. With a sudden sigh, she asked softly, "Just who are you?"
Kent did not answer. Instead, he stood and began to walk away. After a few steps, he glanced back over his shoulder, a faint smile tugging at the corner of his lips.
"You can call me Kent...Kent Madson"

chapters.title: Chapter 941: Heavenly Fate Eye
paragraphs: Kent and Lady Azela casually strolled through the busy streets of the Central Region of Pyris City.
Looking at the expression on Lady Azela’s face, it was clear that she was in shock. Part of the reason was the fact that Kent was holding her hand as if they had known each other for years.
Initially, she didn’t know what Kent was after.
He had only suggested they discuss the Soul Puppet Refining Technique when they left the restaurant.
However, along the way, Kent simply took her hand, and despite her strength, now sitting at the Spirit King stage, she felt as though breaking from his hold would be impossible.
This only added to her second shock, which was the fact that they had passed by dozens of people searching for her, yet none of them even gave her a second glance.
This made her wonder if she was indeed invisible to them.
Kent merely laughed in his head when he saw her behaving so strangely.
’After cultivating the Faceless Art, I learned a few things and managed to apply them in my soul universe.’ Kent smiled, pride written all over his face.
Initially, he never knew he could suppress someone’s cultivation like that. However, after learning the Faceless Art and stealing five faces, he realised something.
The cultivation bases of those he killed were mimicked in the transformation to the point that not even gods could see through it.
However, despite having their cultivation bases, Kent realised he couldn’t utilise them as he should.

He is but a mere Core formation brat, if my miracle he manages to transform into someone with a Spirit King cultivation, Kent realises he can’t use it. People will see him as a Spirit King, but to him, he is merely at the core formation stage.
This meant that aside from having the cultivation base, his body could only handle his own cultivation.
Thanks to this discovery, he managed to learn a small portion of how it truly worked and applied that to Lady Azela’s cultivation.
He merely linked her cultivation base to his soul universe and then transferred the cultivation base of one of the identities he had stolen to her.
This meant that at the moment, she was drawing her spiritual energy from Kent’s soul universe. In a way, the current her was merely a construct Kent had created from his soul universe.
As for her appearance, Kent had again learned a small portion of how the transformation worked in the Faceless Art and recreated it for her.
"If you start to feel any discomfort on your skin, let me know," Kent said, and Lady Azela nodded. In her mind, she was looking at the Transfer Channel 65,000 km away from them.
That was where they were headed, and also where the highest surveillance was.
If they managed to enter the Transfer Channel safely, within seventeen hours, they would arrive on Planet Aerithyne, the fifth-ranked Pill World.
She couldn’t wait to be off-world so she could breathe.
"So what kind of cultivation method does your Heaven’s Eye Sect practice?" Kent asked, curious to learn something about her.
Walking in silence wasn’t something he planned on doing.
Lady Azela hesitated for a moment, but she sighed and began to speak. "My sect cultivates the Heavenly Fates, with most emphasis placed on the Heavenly Fate Eye.
It essentially means we comprehend the three fates, and by harnessing the power of the heavens, we open our eyes to the mysteries of fate.
Our combat power isn’t in any way weaker, but our main strength comes from creating restrictions that go against the soul and mind. We have some strong footing there."
Kent nodded. "So is the Heavenly Fate Eye the cultivation method you all cultivate?"
"Something like that. Not all disciples cultivate the Heavenly Fate Eye. Most venture into the art of Soul and Fate, cultivating something we call the Spirit Eye.
Some individuals pursue the Mind and Fate path, ultimately cultivating the Mind of Fate, while the last group follows the Body of Fate.
These three divisions simply exist to guide one on which path to take."
"Sounds well-structured," Kent nodded, feeling that this path wasn’t too bad. After all, having the ability to read one’s fate is something many would kill for.
During his quest to rise above the Sword King stage in his past life as Jest, he had met someone who possessed a form of cultivation that allowed him to read fate.
Back then, Jest didn’t know if something like that was even real, but he humoured the man. The man claimed he could read his fate.
The result of that interaction left the man utterly terrified to the point that he ran away before Jest even got to hear what the reading was.
He ultimately ruled that the man was a scammer.
"So what path are you walking?" Kent’s Enchanted Eyes didn’t see that far into her, so he was curious.
"I am on the Path of the Soul Spirit Eye."
"Then can you read my fate?" Kent wasn’t even done with his question when Lady Azela suddenly stopped in her tracks.
That was naturally a mistake.
"Hey, watch where you’re going!" somebody shouted.
"Ladies of today. Just from a mere holding of hands, you think you’re on top of the world!"
Kent quickly led her away before more people could descend on them like they did to him yesterday.
"I cannot read your fate," Lady Azela said, though there was a hint of fear in her eyes. She had tried to read Kent’s fate when they first met in the restaurant.
However, even before she began, she sensed a great danger hovering over her, forcing her to retreat immediately.

She had learned long ago that some people simply could not be read. Their fate was unique, and as such, attempting even the slightest curiosity could lead to a karmic backlash—one strong enough to blind her Heavenly Fate Eye forever.
"Too bad. I wanted to know where my fate leads," Kent sighed, but he didn’t dwell on the topic. He knew nothing about fate, so he had no reason to dive into it now.
Sometimes curiosity kills, and he certainly wasn’t ready to step into something that delicate.
"Once we get to Planet Aerithyne, call your mother. I want to have a conversation with her about that man currently waiting for her to come out of the sect."
"What do you plan on telling her?" Lady Azela asked, her face filled with curiosity.
"It is a conversation that will happen between your mother and me, so don’t worry," Kent laughed, but didn’t say much more.

Lady Azela also chose not to dwell on that topic. It took them five hours to walk to their destination. As they approached the location, they sensed a powerful presence wash over them for a split second.
The two acted as if they had sensed nothing and joined the line without a word. There were hundreds of people waiting to head to Planet Aerithyne, so they blended in.
One hour later, it was their turn.
"I want to see some ID," the one in charge demanded, and Kent produced the badge that Pill Monarch Nefeli had given him. When the man saw it, his expression changed.
"I didn’t know the young master would be going off-world today," the man said, now wearing a flattering smile.
Kent furrowed his brow when he heard the man refer to him as young master. However, before he could ask any questions, the man called someone over.
"Young master, this is one of the best attendants. She will ensure you and the Young Miss have a pleasant trip to Planet Aerithyne," the man said with a smile. "Just follow her."
Kent nodded, while Lady Azela wondered just what Kent’s true identity was.
"Your name is?" Kent asked the man.
"This humble servant is called Daniel. If the young master needs anything, he may ask."
"Daniel, huh. I will remember this name."
With that, he and Lady Azela followed the attendant while Daniel smiled happily.

This meant that at the moment, she was drawing her spiritual energy from Kent’s soul universe.
In a way, the current her was merely a construct Kent had created from his soul universe.
As for her appearance, Kent had again learned a small portion of how the transformation worked in the Faceless Art and recreated it for her.
"If you start to feel any discomfort on your skin, let me know," Kent said, and Lady Azela nodded.
In her mind, she was looking at the Transfer Channel 65,000 km away from them.
That was where they were headed, and also where the highest surveillance was.
If they managed to enter the Transfer Channel safely, within seventeen hours, they would arrive on Planet Aerithyne, the fifth-ranked Pill World.
She couldn’t wait to be off-world so she could breathe.
"So what kind of cultivation method does your Heaven’s Eye Sect practice?" Kent asked, curious to learn something about her.
Walking in silence wasn’t something he planned on doing.
Lady Azela hesitated for a moment, but she sighed and began to speak.
"My sect cultivates the Heavenly Fates, with most emphasis placed on the Heavenly Fate Eye.
It essentially means we comprehend the three fates, and by harnessing the power of the heavens, we open our eyes to the mysteries of fate.
Our combat power isn’t in any way weaker, but our main strength comes from creating restrictions that go against the soul and mind.
We have some strong footing there."
Kent nodded.
"So is the Heavenly Fate Eye the cultivation method you all cultivate?"
"Something like that.
Not all disciples cultivate the Heavenly Fate Eye.
Most venture into the art of Soul and Fate, cultivating something we call the Spirit Eye.
Some individuals pursue the Mind and Fate path, ultimately cultivating the Mind of Fate, while the last group follows the Body of Fate.
These three divisions simply exist to guide one on which path to take."
"Sounds well-structured," Kent nodded, feeling that this path wasn’t too bad.
After all, having the ability to read one’s fate is something many would kill for.
During his quest to rise above the Sword King stage in his past life as Jest, he had met someone who possessed a form of cultivation that allowed him to read fate.
Back then, Jest didn’t know if something like that was even real, but he humoured the man.
The man claimed he could read his fate.
The result of that interaction left the man utterly terrified to the point that he ran away before Jest even got to hear what the reading was.
He ultimately ruled that the man was a scammer.
"So what path are you walking?" Kent’s Enchanted Eyes didn’t see that far into her, so he was curious.
"I am on the Path of the Soul Spirit Eye."
"Then can you read my fate?" Kent wasn’t even done with his question when Lady Azela suddenly stopped in her tracks.
That was naturally a mistake.
"Hey, watch where you’re going!" somebody shouted.
"Ladies of today.
Just from a mere holding of hands, you think you’re on top of the world!"
Kent quickly led her away before more people could descend on them like they did to him yesterday.
"I cannot read your fate," Lady Azela said, though there was a hint of fear in her eyes.
She had tried to read Kent’s fate when they first met in the restaurant.
However, even before she began, she sensed a great danger hovering over her, forcing her to retreat immediately.
She had learned long ago that some people simply could not be read.
Their fate was unique, and as such, attempting even the slightest curiosity could lead to a karmic backlash—one strong enough to blind her Heavenly Fate Eye forever.
"Too bad.
I wanted to know where my fate leads," Kent sighed, but he didn’t dwell on the topic.
He knew nothing about fate, so he had no reason to dive into it now.
Sometimes curiosity kills, and he certainly wasn’t ready to step into something that delicate.
"Once we get to Planet Aerithyne, call your mother.
I want to have a conversation with her about that man currently waiting for her to come out of the sect."
"What do you plan on telling her?" Lady Azela asked, her face filled with curiosity.
"It is a conversation that will happen between your mother and me, so don’t worry," Kent laughed, but didn’t say much more.
Lady Azela also chose not to dwell on that topic.
It took them five hours to walk to their destination.
As they approached the location, they sensed a powerful presence wash over them for a split second.
The two acted as if they had sensed nothing and joined the line without a word.
There were hundreds of people waiting to head to Planet Aerithyne, so they blended in.
One hour later, it was their turn.
"I want to see some ID," the one in charge demanded, and Kent produced the badge that Pill Monarch Nefeli had given him.
When the man saw it, his expression changed.
"I didn’t know the young master would be going off-world today," the man said, now wearing a flattering smile.
Kent furrowed his brow when he heard the man refer to him as young master.
However, before he could ask any questions, the man called someone over.
"Young master, this is one of the best attendants.
She will ensure you and the Young Miss have a pleasant trip to Planet Aerithyne," the man said with a smile.
"Just follow her."
Kent nodded, while Lady Azela wondered just what Kent’s true identity was.
"Your name is?" Kent asked the man.
"This humble servant is called Daniel.
If the young master needs anything, he may ask."
"Daniel, huh.
I will remember this name."
With that, he and Lady Azela followed the attendant while Daniel smiled happily.

chapters.title: Chapter 942: Planet Aerithyne
paragraphs: Kent and Lady Azela followed the attendant toward a large ship that hovered two meters above the ground. On the way, Kent pondered what had just happened with Daniel.

He examined the badge inside his space ring for a moment. ’Looks like there is still more to Big Sister Nefeli. The fact that I was just referred to as Young Master either means they saw me as her son or maybe a brother.
I am banking on the latter. But if that is the case, then what kind of background does she have?’
Kent tried to think about this for a moment. However, he wiped the thought from his mind the next second.
’What am I even thinking of? Big Sister is a Pill Monarch. Just that alone is enough to render all these great families useless.’
With that thought registered in his mind, Kent chose not to dwell on it anymore.
’Though being called Young Master does have a nice ring to it. Makes me feel pampered.’ A small smile appeared on his face as they were led to a stand.
Slowly, the stand floated and started lifting them onto the ship.
Lady Azela stood behind Kent, staring daggers at his back. She was now more than ever intrigued to learn more about Kent’s background.

’Once all this is over and I manage to refine a soul puppet, I will investigate his background. Although he is merely a Core Formation cultivator, with how resourceful he is, being on his good side wouldn’t be a bad thing.’
After a few seconds, they landed on the ship, where hundreds of people were already waiting for the channel to open so they could be on their way.

The Transfer Channel was like a teleportation gate. However, instead of sending them instantly to their destination, this one created a channel that linked to another Transfer Channel on Planet Aerithyne.
Once this channel was created, the ship, reinforced with millions of arrays and formations, would fly through it at several times its usual speed.
It was one of the most complex phenomena in the universe that many people struggled to understand.
During the Primordial Era, one had to know the star map to travel between worlds using the void as the natural channel.
But now, one merely needed a star crystal, and they could move through the void without fear of getting lost and appear on a completely different planet.
"Young Master and My Lady, this way please." The attendant led them toward a door. People kept staring at them as they moved. The ship was large, like the ones that ran on the sea.
However, it had some forms of wings made from a material Kent had no idea of, nor any interest in examining.
His focus, however, was on the many combat-ready formations embedded in the ship. ’Looks like travelling through transfer channels isn’t as safe as one might think.’

They were led to a room on the last floor of the ship. It had six floors. However, the architecture and design of the last floor, which was the sixth, were more luxurious, indicating that it was made for VIP travellers.
"Young Master, this is your room. I will come around later to take your order."
Kent smiled. "Don’t worry about that. Just a glass of wine will be enough."
The attendant nodded and, with a gentle bow, left, leaving Kent. He rolled down the window and gazed out, looking over the large expanse of city before his eyes.
"In a few minutes, you will be off-world," Kent said, looking at Lady Azela. "How do you feel about that?"
Lady Azela looked at him but showed no expression that suggested whether she was happy or not. However, she was relieved in her heart...
"I will be happy once I am back in my world and inside my sect."
"I guess you are right. But feel happy knowing you are sitting within the sensing range of your enemy, yet they have no idea."

Lady Azela turned away from Kent and looked toward a building several miles from their location. She showed no reaction, though her eyes said otherwise. Naturally, she was looking at the old man through the Soul Map.
The old man was seated in a lotus posture with his eyes closed, his divine sense spread across a 40,000 km radius.

A 30,000 km sensing range is the maximum for someone who has reached the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage. However, with the old man breaking sixteen limits on his body, he was able to expand his range to 40,000 km.
"Don’t worry, I will be sure to end him and give his soul spirit to you," Kent said with a lazy expression. Naturally, he planned on cleaning house.
Knowing the Blue Flame Pill Palace was looking to take over the Pyris Pill Alliance, he felt the need to act.
And now that he had a reason, taking out two scums that could threaten his future investment seemed logical.
After a three-hour wait, the ship was ready to depart.
Creating the transfer channel took three minutes. However, the moment it opened, the ship rose into the air and soon zoomed into the transfer channel, beginning its journey through the void.
The moment they left Planet Pyris, Lady Azela let out a sigh.
Kent smiled. ’Saving fairies both in the future and the past does feel nice.’
Seeing Lady Azela close her eyes and slowly enter a meditative state made his smile widen. He knew she had been panicking the entire time, so she needed the quiet to calm her nerves.
Kent also closed his eyes and decided to handle his current mental state. The issue with his memories from his past life as Chaos still weighed heavily on his heart.
He plans to fix his mind before going back to the future.
Soon, he entered a state that sent him back to the moment he discovered Elina’s bloodied body. This time, however, he was merely observing as an outsider.
Time flew by, and Kent remained in that state. He made sure to note down every last detail of that horrible moment that had forever changed his life.
After having had enough, he pulled his mind back to the present and chose to suppress his emotions for now. A time would come for him to unleash his fury.
’Elina, if you’ve reincarnated, I hope you are living a good life. The universe owes that much,’ Kent sighed.
’I will find you even if it means killing my way through the universe. Nothing will stop me from finding you.’

Lady Azela, who was looking at Kent’s face, felt a chill run down her spine when Kent opened his eyes and their gazes met. She withdrew her gaze immediately, unsure if she could hold her composure if she maintained eye contact for long.
Kent didn’t say anything and merely looked out the window.
"We’ve arrived, Young Master." The attendant knocked on the door at that very moment and informed them of their arrival.
"Let’s go." Kent led the way, and soon, they were back on the deck of the ship.
"Welcome to Thyne City, Young Master," the attendant said. "This is the capital city of this planet and the most wonderful place to be."
Kent nodded and immediately activated the Soul Map. Soon, the 80,000 km radius was within his reach.
"I guess we will be on our way." The attendant nodded and led them to the platform that carried them back down. Soon, Kent and Lady Azela made their way toward a tall pagoda standing 75,000 km away.

chapters.title: Chapter 943: FaceTime With Lady Azela’s Mom
paragraphs: "Where are we going?" Lady Azela asked, walking beside Kent as they headed deeper into the city. Now that she was out of reach of the Blue Flame Pill Palace, she seemed more relaxed.
Kent looked at her and smiled. "We are heading toward the Aerithyne Pill Alliance headquarters."
"What are we going to do there?" she asked again.

"I have a duel with some arrogant Pill Saint who just hasn’t met her match yet," Kent smirked and shook his head, already planning the best way to humiliate the Pill Saint that he had to come from 370,000 years in the future just to defeat.
"So you are an Alchemist," Lady Azela said, now realising why they were heading in the direction of a place only Alchemists dared go.
"First, however, we have to make a quick stop. I must talk to your mother and let her know of the sequence of events that will happen in the coming days."
"Events like?"

"Killing that Vince guy, of course." Kent pulled her away from the road, and they entered an inn. He booked a room, and soon, they were inside a not-so-lavish room, but it was good enough to accommodate what he had planned on doing.
"So you are actually planning on going after him?" Lady Azela didn’t immediately call her mother. She got curious and asked Kent a question.
To her, once she got back to her sect, not only would she be unreachable even if someone like the Old Man in Pyris City came, but they might actually be running to their death.
The formation protecting her sect was enough to kill a cultivator at the Peak Heaven Ascension stage.
According to her plans, once they returned to her sect, she could disregard all those on the outside and focus on refining the Soul Spirit into a Soul Puppet.

Naturally, if he succeeded on that front, then not only would she have an even more powerful helper, but she could then come out for revenge on the people who sought to kill her and take what she rightfully owned.
Kent knew what she was thinking, but he still made her aware of why he planned on going after the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
"I won’t be going after them for you. That is not why I will be killing him. The reason has something to do with the fact that they have a Soul Extinguishing Pill in their possession.
Do you know that one of the forbidden pills in existence is the Soul Extinguishing Pill? To make one, over a thousand souls of mortals are required as the main ingredient.
So the fact that they have one, even if they aren’t the ones who made it, I must punish them." A look of disdain appeared on Kent’s face.
"The path of Pill Making is sacred, so to tarnish it this far is something I would not tolerate."
Lady Azela examined Kent’s expression for a few minutes before taking out the orb that allowed her to talk to her mother.
She set it down and then drew some array symbols in the air before channelling her energy into the orb.
Almost as if her mother had been waiting for her call, the orb glowed blue, and a face appeared on it.
"Azela, where are you? Are you okay?" The woman, whose appearance was not much older than Lady Azela’s, spoke rather quickly when she saw her daughter’s face.
It was after she asked the questions that she saw Kent smiling at her.
"Who are you?" the woman asked, her eyes narrowing as she looked at the handsome brat who had his hand resting on Lady Azela’s shoulder.
"You can call me Kent, the man who will be delivering your daughter to you in one piece." The woman on the other end didn’t say anything when she heard Kent’s words.
She turned to her daughter, and while they didn’t make it obvious, Kent knew they used their eyes to communicate. This only added to the smile on Kent’s face.
He didn’t know how a grown-up like Lady Azela could still appear like a baby before her mother.
’In a way, it kind of looks cute,’ Kent said in his head and waited for the two ladies to end their conversation with their eyes.
"You said your name is Kent, right?" the lady asked.
"The one and only."
"My name is Kami. I am the Ancestor of the Heaven’s Eye Sect and Azela’s mother. Tell me, Kent, when will you be bringing my daughter?"

"I have some business on planet Aerithyne, but once I am done, I will head toward your world. From what I’ve learned, your world from where I am currently will take one week to reach, so expect your daughter in seven days, maybe eight at most, once I am done with my work here."
"If you manage to bring her, like I promised, I will reward you greatly," Lady Kami said, and Kent smiled.
"I look forward to that. However, I didn’t call to tell you when we will arrive in your world. I called to have you send a message to someone for me."
"Who?"
"His name is Vince. I believe he is the Vice Leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace and the one pursuing your daughter.
I have reason to believe he is currently in your world and surrounded by your sect, along with seven other powerful cultivators.
I don’t know how he managed to get to your world that fast, but he is daring, and I want a message to reach him."

Kent could see it; the lady shuddered when she heard his words. Of course, that shudder wasn’t from fear but from anger—anger so strong that, had it not been for her daughter cooling her down, she would have dashed out to teach the bastards a lesson.
"Relax, Mom, listen to what Kent has to say first."
"I am listening."
Kent smiled. "Write some words on a scroll and send it flying from the sect. Make sure it goes out fast, and it must contain some of your aura so they can easily sense it."
"What words should I write in the scroll?"

Kent smiled weakly. "Tell the old man from the Blue Flame Pill Palace to stop wasting his time. Lady Azela has long since left Pyris City, right under his nose. If he wants to get her back, he should scream his soul out and walk down the street naked.
But before that, he can go collect the bodies of his people, who will long be dead by the time he finishes reading this message.

Also, inform him that he will be penalised for possessing a Soul Extinguishing Pill. I will also report this to the Pill Alliances in every Pill World and make sure that after he is dead, his legacy, the Blue Flame Pill Palace, will be demolished and forgotten.
One last thing, tell him not to open the package that will be delivered in two days. It was meant for somebody else."
By the time Kent was done with his words, both Lady Azela and her mother could only stare at him with widened eyes.
"I want all I said written verbatim. Not even a single comma should be missed."
Kent laughed. "You can sign it with the name Chaos."

By the time Kent was done with his words, both Lady Azela and her mother could only stare at him with widened eyes.
"I want all I said written verbatim.
Not even a single comma should be missed."
Kent laughed.
"You can sign it with the name Chaos."

chapters.title: Chapter 944: Kent’s Care Package
paragraphs: [Planet Nictus - Heaven’s Eye Sect - Lady Kami’s POV]
It had only been three minutes after Lady Kami’s conversation with Kent. However, even after the conversation, she couldn’t help but shudder whenever she thought of the words Kent told her to write.

They sounded like a joke when Kent was saying them. However, if she were to take in Kent’s expression while saying those words, not only did he appear like the greatest evil she had ever seen, but also the most dangerous person she had ever laid eyes on.
From mere words and expression, Kent managed to leave an impression on her—one that, at the moment, she could only pray in her heart that her daughter would be delivered to her in one piece.
She was seated behind a table with a few blank scrolls and ink on it, so she went to work right away.
After thirty minutes, she managed to put down everything Kent said, not even missing a single word or even a comma.
She furled the scroll, tied it with a silver rope, and flew out of the room.
The Heaven’s Eye Sect was a grand sight to behold.
It was situated in a mountainous area, with most of the buildings constructed using jade crystals and other rare minerals.

One could even tell from the mere aura surrounding the place that the power of fate was deeply rooted in the sect. However, while that was true, there was also a strange sense of familiarity—one that, if Kent were around, he would sense.
The aura of Chaos energy. It was faint, but as Lady Kami flew past that area, the shockwaves following her seemed to affect the Chaos energy, causing the plants around to die instantly.
After flying for a few minutes, which in fact had moved her several miles from her resting area, she brought out the scroll and coated it with her energy before throwing it away.
It vanished from sight in an instant, and then she retreated back to her resting area. If something unusual happened, she would learn about it in the days to come.
[20 miles from the Heaven’s Eye Sect - Eastern Border]
Just twenty miles away from the sect, three Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivators were seated in lotus posture, their senses spread wide, covering a large part of the sect’s outer regions.
The formations there were much weaker, allowing them to see through them.
They had been keeping a close eye on things around the sect, to the point that when something suddenly flashed across the horizon, all three of them noticed and vanished.

A few seconds later, they appeared in the air, one of them grabbing the scroll that was flying out of the sect. They quickly opened it, and when they read the first two lines, their faces turned pale.
"Call the Vice Leader now."
[30 miles from the Heaven’s Eye Sect - Southern Border]

Vince, the Vice Leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace, was seated in a lotus posture with his senses spread. Because of his powerful Mind and Soul, he was able to see much further into the Elders in the outer section of the sect.
He had arrived a few hours after the auction.

He knew the chances of Lady Azela escaping back to her world were high, so he used a method that cost a fortune to reach Planet Nictus much faster. This way, he would be able to intercept her when she came.

However, it had already been hours, and the elders he had called had also arrived. But despite all borders of the sect being sealed by them, Lady Azela and her mother had not entered his sensing range or that of the elders.
This clearly didn’t sit well with him, and he was furious.
Suddenly, his communication crystal activated, and he readily took it out, expecting some good news.
However, when the voice spoke, his face darkened.
"Vice Leader, we have a problem."
[Planet Pyris - Pyris City - The Old Man’s POV]
"What did you just say?" The old man, who was keeping a close eye on the events happening around the only off-world Transfer Channel in Pyris City, exclaimed in a shocked tone.

"Leader, the lady left Pyris City, and from what it appears, she has a powerful helper called Chaos. I also have reasons to believe he killed most of our men," the Vice Leader said, now holding the scroll sent from the Heaven’s Eye Sect.
"What is the meaning of all this?" the old man asked, looking around the room he was in. "Somebody, contact the various men we have on watch in this city."
One of the men with him in the room took out a communication crystal and started contacting them. Three minutes went by, and none of them replied.
Then ten minutes passed, and there was still silence.

At this very instant, the old man sensed something was amiss, so he ordered his men to investigate. Twenty minutes later, reports started coming in of the dead bodies of their men found at their posts.
The report included the way they died, which was through poison that seemed to have been laced on the steamed buns that all of them held in their hands.
This was so shocking that the old man didn’t know what to do.
"What should we do, Leader? Attacking the Heaven’s Eye Sect is suicide unless you have a Master of Fate or a formation expert who can counter that Damned Formation.
If not, then I am afraid we have just lost the Soul Spirit, and what is even worse, the worlds will soon know we have a Forbidden Pill.
This is bad," Vince said, looking at the scroll in his hands.
"Retreat back to Pyris, and we will figure something out." Vince nodded and sent word to the other elders.

They left a few minutes later and began heading to the nearest Transfer Channel that would take them back to Pyris. At the moment, they were more concerned about the fact that an outsider knew they had a Forbidden Pill.
The Soul Spirit could wait. Their new target now was the mysterious Chaos.
However, one thing Vince overlooked was the last few sentences on the scroll. He recalled them two days into their travel back to Pyris. By then, it was too late to call and inform him.
[Kent’s Care Package]
Two days after Kent and Lady Azela left Pyris City, an item was delivered to the Blue Flame Pill Palace’s main base. By then, the old man was back there preparing for what was coming.
Naturally, the item was addressed to the Vice Leader. However, since the old man was around, they sent it to him.
There was a note on it that read, "From Chaos to the Dark Elf."
Seeing a familiar name, he tore open the package, and inside he found a small jade box. He readily took it and opened it.
However, his face darkened the next second when he breathed in something he was all too familiar with.
"Bone Corroding Poison." His face turned pale, and he fell back, landing hard on the ground. He couldn’t even call for help before passing out.
Because he had ordered everyone to stay clear of his mansion, he would remain unconscious for three more days. By then, the Vice Leader would have arrived.
When he saw the state of their leader, he would finally know the kind of monster they had provoked and the kind of danger hovering over their heads.

chapters.title: Chapter 945: Why the long face, are you Scared
paragraphs: "It worked like you said it would. After throwing the scroll out, they sensed it and took it. After a while, they left and headed straight to the Transfer Channel," Lady Kami said, speaking to Kent and Lady Azela.
It had only been two days since Kent spoke with her.
However, within those two days, she had searched through a major part of the city where the sect was located, and to her shock, not even a hair of the people who came after her could be found.
This made her understand just how great the threat of exposing the forbidden Pill they possess could be.
"In truth, I never expected them to take the bait, but since it all worked out, I hope that Dark Elf makes it in time for his package."
Lady Kami smiled slightly and then asked what was next.
"I will let your daughter call you when we are ready to head to your planet. Until then, keep a close eye on your surroundings. Who knows, they might come back."
Lady Kami nodded and cut the connection. The past two days had been wild for her, so she could finally rest, knowing her daughter would soon return to her.
After the call ended, Kent walked toward the window of the inn and extended the soul map further toward the Pagoda standing 45,000 km from his current location.

"12 Heavenly Ascension stage warriors, huh. Looks like I have to work on my pill flame before going there," Kent said inwardly before focusing his attention on a certain lady seated on the 5th floor of the Pagoda.
She had short brown hair and clear blue eyes.
Her ears aren’t human ears, as they extend much longer. With her short hair, one can see just how long they really are. Naturally, she was an elf, or more specifically, an Earth Elf.
This part of the universe appeared to have beings with a greater affinity for the elements. Just as there were Elemental Humans, she also seemed to come from an Elemental Elf race.

Kent scanned her cultivation and saw that she had recently entered the Spirit Lord stage. This made him scoff, knowing that even if there were ten of them, judging by the aura around her, he could crush them into meat paste.
This lady was Pill Saint Flura, the one Kent had to defeat to ultimately step into the ranks of a Pill Saint.
Kent had only come to the past for three things.
The first was to defeat this lady and comprehend the Grand Pill Tablet. He had already accomplished one, leaving him with the second, which he was about to face in a few hours.
The second was to form his Blood Core Gate. Naturally, this would require him to go on a killing spree. He planned on asking Lady Azela where he could go for that.
Lastly, he planned to form at least 10,000 Flame Veins before returning to the future. The plans he had were ones he knew could be achieved if he became much stronger.
He wouldn’t be going to a Low, Legacy, or Great High World. His plan was to venture into the Supreme High World, where the best opportunities were.

After meeting the Slaughter King twice, Kent saw just how much he was still lacking. He didn’t want to feel inferior again, so the plan now was to become much stronger than he would have become if he hadn’t met the Slaughter King.
"I might as well add one Blood Life Seal and one Blood Death Seal to the mix. With the Forsaken Race now under my radar, who knows when I will be meeting them again?"
He walked back to Lady Azela. "I am going to the Aerithyne Pill Pagoda for a duel. However, before that, I plan to buy a Flame Spirit from a store a couple of miles away.
You’re welcome to stay here if you’d like. Once I am done with my business, we will head to your world next."
"I will go with you. Although my strength has been suppressed to the Spirit King stage, I still have the means to utilise my Heavenly Ascension skills, so I will be able to protect you that way."
Kent smiled weakly, hearing the woman speak. Although he couldn’t kill her in normal combat, Kent knew the moment he unleashed the Asteroid, she was as good as dead.
"If you are worried, thinking that I will abandon you, then don’t be. I plan on learning the technique for refining Soul Puppets, so I will come back for you."
Lady Azela shook her head. "Still, I will follow you. Until you get me to my world, treat this partnership as a life-or-death one."
"Fine." Kent chose to end the conversation there. "On that note, we should get going." Kent opened the door for Lady Azela, and so they left, heading to the store.
Kent planned on buying a Tier Nine pill flame and a Cauldron.
He didn’t want to expose his Tier 12 Soul Flame, so getting a secondary one was for the best. After all, Nana had created the foundation for him to own a second flame.
All he needed to do now was buy a suitable flame spirit and absorb it.
Meanwhile, on the 5th floor of the Aerithyne Pill Alliance Pagoda, Pill Saint Flura looked at the faces of the hundred Pill Saints she had defeated and smirked.
"Bunch of idiots. A common Tier 9 pill they couldn’t concoct."
Beside her, a young lady about her age, though much more ordinary-looking compared to the clothes Pill Saint Flura was wearing, smiled.
"The young miss has already been recognised by a Pill Monarch for her outstanding brilliance in Alchemy, so it is only normal that they couldn’t measure up to your brilliance."

Pill Saint Flura smiled. "You always know how to cheer me up, Niki. But what you said is indeed true. Aside from the annoying bitch from the Nymbra Pill Alliance, none managed to make me even try at all."
"That bitch was indeed a pain. But the fact that the young miss managed to defeat her shows just how brilliant and amazing you are."

Niki paused for a moment, then added, "I am sure the young miss will come out prosperous in the Pill Ascension Competition. After that, the young miss can take the trial and become a Pill Sage and then Pill King soon."
Pill Saint Flura smiled again. "That is only natural, Niki. My talent is better suited to making Tier 10 pills."

An hour passed, but nobody came to accept her challenge. This only fueled her arrogance to the point that she started cursing at the Pill Saints around. A few who merely came there to watch even caught some stray bullets.
However, knowing her background, none said anything and merely seethed inwardly. They knew that when the Pill Ascension Competition came, they would have their revenge.
If only they knew their revenge would come from a handsome, purple-haired person who walked into the Pagoda by flashing his pill badge at the guards.
Soon, Kent was on the 5th floor and started walking toward Pill Saint Flura.
Kent’s appearance stunned everyone, for they could all sense his cultivation base. Core Formation warriors weren’t invited to the 5th floor.
However, Kent ignored their stares and walked toward the arrogant Pill Saint.
"I am Kent, a Pill Grandmaster from the Pyris Pill Alliance. I have come to accept your challenge." An expression of shock appeared on Pill Saint Flura’s face.
However, it immediately changed to anger when Kent added a few words.
"Why the long face? Are you scared?"

chapters.title: Chapter 946: Just Tier Nine?
paragraphs: For a moment, the entire fifth floor of the pagoda became quiet like a cemetery.
None of them, regardless of how much they hated Pill Saint Flura, could fathom just where Kent gathered the courage to ask that last question.
’Why the long face, are you scared?’
The sentence was echoing in their heads as they looked at Kent, who held a small smile on his face. Lady Azela stood behind him, her face expressionless.
Naturally, she was equally taken aback, for she never expected Kent to accept the challenge of a Pill Saint and, to some extent, taunt her.
’So when he said he had a business here, this was what he meant,’ she wondered while keeping the calm look on her face.
Thanks to seeing a much more shocking side of Kent in the past few days, she was able to handle this one well.
However, the onlookers, Niki and her young miss Pill Saint Flura, weren’t that lucky.
The shocked and angry expression on Pill Saint Flura’s face was just too much for everyone to ignore, and they knew what was about to happen.
Pill Saint Flura exploded in anger, one that caused her aura to flare out, pushing Niki and Lady Azela back.
Naturally, Lady Azela was but a Spirit King, with Flura recently stepping into the Spirit Lord stage. So she was much stronger than her in her current body.
She took a couple of steps back, and her eyes narrowed. However, she restrained herself when she realised she was but a mere Spirit King.
Aside from that, seeing Kent’s hand behind him like an unconcerned citizen, she sighed in her heart, though she was taken aback for a moment there.
Kent looked at Pill Saint Flura, who now had a shocked expression on her face.
The anger she felt was now replaced by shock, and even, to some degree, a scared expression, as she saw that Kent didn’t even take a step back after she released her Spirit Lord cultivation.

"Not impressed," Kent said with a chuckle and a look of contempt, "I met Core Formation cultivators with stronger auras than yours. If your alchemy skills are as weak as your aura, then you might as well give me the Pill Ascension token so I can be on my way."
Kent flew to a stage prepared for the competition and sat behind the one without a cauldron. He waved his hand, and a cauldron he bought on his way here appeared.

He turned and looked at Pill Saint Flura, who still couldn’t understand what had happened. For a moment, she felt insulted; however, when she saw the badge floating before her eyes, she knew this was real.
"A mere Pill Grandmaster dares be arrogant before me." She grabbed Kent’s Pyris Alliance Pill badge and threw it at him. Kent caught it in a firm grip.

Although he couldn’t retrieve items from the tower storage, sacrificing his days in the past could open a small window of opportunity for him, so he sacrificed 70 days just to retrieve his pill badge.
It was painful, but Kent knew he needed it.
He also promised himself that before coming to the past again, he would put everything into the Soul Universe.

"I may be a mere Pill Grandmaster who dares accept your challenge. But what about you? A mere Pill Saint dares be arrogant, challenging those she knew she could win over." Kent looked at the pill around for a moment before turning back to Pill Saint Flura.
"If a Pill Saint from the top-ranking Pill Alliance were to come, can you defeat them?"
The question hit hard, but Kent wasn’t done...
"All you did was throw a challenge against the weak and less experienced just so you can feel better." A look of disgust appeared on Kent’s face...
"As an Alchemist, I have to say you are a disgrace to all Alchemists. If you are that good, why didn’t you challenge a Pill Sage or even a Pill King?"
At this point, all those who lost against Pill Saint Flura and those who caught stray bullets from her were giving Kent thumbs up in their hearts.
They didn’t know where Kent came from, but they were glad he had come to offer his head on the chopping block, so they could feel better about their defeats against Pill Saint Flura.
"I don’t have much time, so if you are done looking at me with those twisted eyes, can we get to the part where I discipline you on the path of pill making?"
Seated among the onlookers was a man with sharp eyes. His focus was on Kent from the moment he announced he was from Pyris Pill Alliance.
At first, he had planned to reveal himself as the man Pill Monarch Nefeli had asked to come and ensure Kent’s safety. However, before he could make a move, Kent’s voice entered his head.
"Don’t blow your cover yet. Once I get the token, I will give it to you, like Pill Monarch Nefeli told me to."
These words made him slow down and start to observe everything.

’Even if he wins and gets the token, he wouldn’t be able to move even an inch inside the Pill Ascension Realm, considering he had angered someone from that arrogant yet powerful family.’
He sighed but chose not to do anything.

Like Kent said, he shouldn’t break his cover yet, for he would be the getaway car. He was banking on the mysterious token that caused hundreds of people to accept a challenge they were doomed to fail at.
"Very well. You said your name is Kent, right? I will be sure to teach you what happens when you insult someone like me." Pill Saint Flura also flew and landed on the stage.
"Oh, please, don’t act like you are some sanctimonious person. You set this trap yourself, and so you must be prepared to be trapped in it.
As to what comes after, you will soon understand why my name is Kent."
The moment Pill Saint Flura landed on the stage, a Pill Sage appeared, and everyone went quiet.

He looked at Kent with a frown, but the brat merely smirked. He wasn’t being arrogant for nothing. In Kent’s eyes, he wanted this duel to be his debut, for it was bound to spread. When that happened, his status within the Pyris Pill Alliance would skyrocket.
Naturally, that would just be the start. He had made a name for himself as a swordsman; he planned to make one for himself as an Alchemist.
"The rules are simple," the Pill Sage spoke, "You both have 5 hours to concoct a Tier 9 Bone Tempering Pill—"

"Just Tier Nine?" Kent cut the Pill Sage off, causing the man’s face to contort into an angry one. He didn’t know if he should just grab Kent by the ear and beat his backside for his unruly behaviour.
"Sorry... you can continue," Kent said with an apologetic smile.

The Pill Sage sneered and continued, "You will each concoct a Tier 9 Bone Tempering Pill. The one with the highest purity will be the winner. Know that a Pill King will appraise the pill so there will be no mistakes."
When he ended, two lady Pill Saints brought two portions of ingredients to both Kent and Pill Saint Flura.
"If you waste both portions, you lose." The Pill Sage looked at Kent when he made that statement; however, Kent merely smiled.
"On that note, you can start..."

The sentence was echoing in their heads as they looked at Kent, who held a small smile on his face.
Lady Azela stood behind him, her face expressionless.
