chapters.title: Chapter 947: Handicap
paragraphs: The moment the man gave the order, Pill Saint Flura lit her pill flame.
Kent looked at the blue flame on her palm, and his eyes narrowed.
’A tier ten pill flame, huh?’
Pill Saint Flura, who misunderstood what Kent’s expression meant, sneered, "No need to despair yet. The fun hasn’t even begun yet."
Kent raised his brow and laughed, "Have you ever heard this saying, that ’a princess with no brain on her head is still an idiot?’"
Kent chuckled, "It is the same as a Pill Saint with good flame but no knowledge, who will lose to a mere Pill Grandmaster with a Tier 9 pill flame."

Kent lit his pill flame, causing a yellow flame to appear in his palm. However, a few seconds later, he put away his pill flame and instead chose to look at the Pill Saint, who also chose to ignore Kent.
So far, when it came to the verbal conflict, Kent has the upper hand. So she knew if she continued to banter with him, she might just lose focus and burn her ingredients.
After she won, she would have the chance to gloat.
Kent didn’t mind her sudden quietness. He knew why she made that decision, so he merely sat there and started to look at her.
After 15 minutes of heating the cauldron, she opened it, added one ingredient, and began extracting the medicinal essence.
’That is all I need to see to know she has lost even before the race began.’ Kent smiled, sat properly in a lotus posture, and closed his eyes.
When the onlookers saw this, their minds flipped...
"Is it just me, or is this Pill Grandmaster overdoing it... I mean, accepting a challenge from a Pill Saint as a Pill Grandmaster is already enough. Why go as far as giving her a handicap?"
"What do you expect? The saying that the arrogant always have someone more arrogant than they are is true. Today, this young man has proved that saying."
"He is just sitting there like he wasn’t concerned at all."
"Maybe he has given up."
More murmurs began to spread as everyone shared their opinions about Kent’s character. None was even focused on the Pill Saint, for they had already seen what she could do.
Kent, however, is a newcomer with a big mouth and a rude character. They wanted to see if his skills matched his mouth.

On the last floor of the Pagoda, three people, each with a cultivation base of a Peak Heavenly Ascension and soul power that could nullify the effect of even a Tier 18 Soul Extinguishing Pill, sat with a calm look on their faces.
If someone who knew the dynamics of the Pill World were to see them, they would recognise them as the three Pill Sovereigns of the Aerithyne Pill Alliance.
They are alchemists with the means of concocting Tier 14 and Tier 15 pills, said to invoke Pill Tribulation every time one is made.
Those tribulations are, in a way, dangerous if care is not taken, so their importance in a high world is greatly appreciated..
Before one can be recognised as a Pill Sovereign, they must concoct at least three Tier 14 Pills and pass the pill tribulations.

It is one of the critical junctions in the path of pill making, and these three have been through this trial and are now recognised as Pill Sovereigns. The Pyris Pill Alliance has only one Pill Sovereign, one of the many reasons why it ranks 7th.
They all seemed to be staring in the same direction, which was the 5th floor.
"This kid is arrogant," one of them, by the name Pill Sovereign Ric, said, his gaze calm.

"What do you expect? As someone who managed to join an alliance as a Pill Grandmaster, even if it is a lowly one like the Pyris Pill Alliance, he has some leeway to be arrogant." Pill Sovereign Okra responded, keeping a close eye on Kent.
Pill Sovereign Bryn held a calm look on his face as he looked at Kent. To him, this brat had already done enough that he deserved to be punished.

Even if a Pill Saint were to be arrogant, a Pill Grandmaster had no place to lecture them. However, since Kent wasn’t from the alliance, there was nothing he could do but wait for Pill Saint Flura to win.
"Let’s just watch. I want to see where this arrogance of his is coming from," he said.
On the 5th floor, Kent sat with his eyes closed, and even after 30 minutes had passed, he remained like that.
Soon, 1 hour had passed.
Pill Saint Flura had already extracted five out of the nine ingredients required for the Bone Tempering Pill. At her pace, she would finish extracting everything in the next 30 minutes.
However, even after she was left with two more to go, Kent remained seated in lotus posture with his eyes closed.
Pill Saint Flura didn’t mind Kent’s action and continued to focus on her work.
The man who was sent by Pill Monarch Nefeli sat with his arms crossed and eyes narrowed at Kent. He didn’t know what Kent was doing, nor did he want to know.
At the moment, the reputation of the Pyris Pill Alliance was on the line, and as a Pill Emperor, he knew if Kent didn’t do anything by the time 2 hours were over, he would lose.
Extracting the essence from the ingredient takes time, and so if he wasted time by just sitting there, he would lose. He even wanted to shout at him, but he knew better than to do that.
So just like he feared, when 2 hours passed and Pill Saint Flura had long finished extracting the essence from her herbs, he only sighed.
Meanwhile, inside Kent’s Mind Space, a pill hovered before him as he sat in a lotus posture, admiring it.
"Although I achieved 100% on my first trial, my Enchanted Eyes told me she had achieved 100% purity in all the challenges she had with those losers.
This means I must surpass her, and the only way out is pill rings. If I can form a pill ring, she will lose for sure."
Kent smiled and added, "Although she is hateful, she has some talent as an alchemist. I merely put on the show for my own sake, but defeating her is also not a problem."
Kent saw Pill Saint Flura’s information using his Enchanted Eye. The lady is brilliant, and Kent knew that. But he couldn’t let her gloat like that...
"Thankfully, Nana gave me a Pill Ring Refining Technique, and another technique that allowed me to work on an imaginary pill inside my Mind Space."
The techniques Nana gave him are out of this world. Kent didn’t know why she was so keen on him becoming even more brilliant as an alchemist than he was in the past, but he appreciated it.
He knew with this head start she had given him, his name would soon spread far and wide.
"Now that I know what to do, I guess it is time for me to do the real thing." By the time Kent opened his eyes, two and a half hours had passed.
By then, Pill Saint Flura was burning impurities from the medicinal essence extracted.
Kent stood up and stretched, then he yawned, causing people to look at him weirdly.
When he sat down, his flame lit up, and then, without even heating the cauldron, he slapped his side, and the lid flew off, hovering in the air.
His left hand moved, and three 3-ingredient roses rose into the air. When everyone saw this, their expressions changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 948: Triple Extraction
paragraphs: Just as in Swordsmanship, there are those who can wield sword energies far beyond the standards of their rank; in alchemy, dual extraction is considered to be such.
In fact, in alchemy, dual extraction is something only Pill Kings and above would dare attempt. It is considered something only the best and the brightest would ever attempt.
However, looking at Kent with widened eyes at the moment, they couldn’t help but open their mouths, shock written all over their faces as they took in what he was doing.
"Please tell me I am not seeing things."
"You are not. This Kent is doing triple extraction, something not even Pill Emperors dare attempt."
"But how is that even possible? How can a mere Pill Grandmaster be able to do triple extraction? Only Pill Monarch and above can do that."
"What if he is not a Pill Grandmaster? What if he had disguised his rank?"
"That is possible. However, I don’t think he had done something like that."
"How sure are you?"

"Because nobody will be stupid enough to disguise their rank and come to a rival territory just to score some brownie points. I mean, would you dare disguise your rank and walk into a place ruled by three Pill Sovereigns?"
"You have a point there. However, if he hadn’t disguised himself, then does it mean he really is a Pill Grandmaster? How the hell is he doing triple extraction then?"
That idea alone was making everyone stare at Kent in shock.
The Pill Emperor, seated among the onlookers, was equally shocked. He is a Pill Emperor, but even he can’t do triple extraction.
In fact, he was still struggling with the dual extraction whenever he had two major ingredients in his furnace. At best, he can handle a minor and a major ingredient simultaneously.
But Kent had just thrown three main ingredients into the cauldron, and he was extracting the essence without a sigh of discomfort or struggle.
’Who is this monster, and just where did Pill Monarch Nefeli get him from?’ he couldn’t help wondering.
’If these words spread out, people are going to flip.’ A smile appeared on his lips when he realised Kent was from the same Pill Alliance as him.
Kent’s success will reflect positively on the Pyris Pill Alliance.

As for Lady Azela, she was equally shaken when she saw Kent put three ingredients into the cauldron. She doesn’t know much about alchemy. However, she knew enough to understand what Kent had done and how shockingly amazing that was.
’He is full of surprises,’ she said inwardly as she continued to look at Kent.
As for Pill Saint Flura, she was so focused on burning the impurities from the essence she had extracted from the ingredients that she didn’t even notice Kent.
In her mind, Kent is cooked, so she might as well ignore him.

Perhaps that was for the best, considering that what Kent was doing wasn’t only too shocking, but he would have made her falter, which, at the state she was in, a slight mistake would be all it would take to destroy everything for her.
After 20 minutes, Kent used his left hand again to make three more ingredients float and enter the cauldron. This showed he had finished extracting the essence from the first ingredients.
However, while that was impressive, Kent also now had to handle three more extractions while holding onto the three essences he had extracted.
The reason it’s hard is that with the single extraction, he merely had to merge the essences with each other after adding a new ingredient to the cauldron.
This is done step by step, as mixing two essences together not only follows a sacred rule but also has a defined method for every pill.
The three essences he had extracted cannot be mixed; he must hold onto them all the same, extracting the three new ingredients.
After another twenty minutes, Kent added the last three, and within an hour, he had extracted all nine ingredients.
’I have less than two more hours to go,’ Kent thought, and then looked at Pill Saint Flura, who was almost done burning impurities.

’She is rather brilliant. Looks like she is using the same method as mine. condensing while burning impurities.’ Kent couldn’t help acknowledging his opponent’s intelligence. However, he wasn’t intimidated.
If anything, he was up for the challenge.
Kent adjusted his flame strength and also began burning impurities.
’Nana taught me how to go about Clean Extraction. However, that method is too complex. I don’t have the time to look at that like I did with the method on how to do Dual Extraction.’
In truth, Nana had done more than Kent said.

Before meeting her, Kent had only four enlightenments, all of which were related to pill refining. In fact, Kent had been aiming for Dual Extraction when he learned of how amazing the Pill Princess was.

So he delved deeper into that, and when he met Nana, she took him even further. The methods she showed Kent are Dual Extraction, which, thanks to the three enlightenments he had after, has now deepened his understanding to the point where he has achieved Triple Extraction.

The second is Dual Pill Concoction, which involves creating two pills simultaneously. For that, Kent can’t start to think of it since even Pill Monarchs can only attempt that with Tier 9 and below pills.
The third, however, pertains to Clean Extraction. This method is something Kent used during the extraction process, which, from the look of things, he still needed to practice some more.
The ideal result was for him to extract an impurity-free essence from the ingredients, which, if achieved, would enable him to condense and refine the pill without concern for impurities.
If Kent had extracted the herbs one by one, he would have achieved that, but with Triple Extraction, there was some residue of impurities in the extracted essence.
However, the impurities left in the medicinal essence aren’t significant, so Kent chose to proceed with the best course of action, which involves simultaneously condensing and burning the impurities.
As he changed the flame technique, the Pill Sovereigns on the last floor and a few others on the 6th, 7th, and 8th floors raised their brows.

Most recognised what Kent was doing, and while they could do the same, a Pill Grandmaster has no business doing that. In fact, most stood from their seats and appeared on the 5th floor just to witness Kent’s brilliance.
Within minutes, a powerful Alchemist appeared on the 5th floor, but Kent ignored them all, for he knew what he was doing was something extraordinary.
Half an hour later, Pill Saint Flura’s pill formed, and the smell of a Pure Bone Tempering Pill spread all over, causing many to admire her brilliance.
It was already three and a half hours since the start of the contest, but she had already formed her pill. Naturally, that is something worth being proud of.
Pill Saints had no business concocting Tier 8 and 9 pills. Those are meant for Pill Sages. However, the brightest in the Pill Path can be extraordinary.
It was also one of the many reasons why there are not many Pill Sages with extraordinary talents.
Most Pill Saints, once they become Pill Sages, will, within months, take the Pill King Trial, which requires them to concoct three Tier 9 pills within 24 hours.
However, even without these rankings, what Pill Saint Flura had done was already amazing. However, she was overshadowed by Kent, who also condensed his pill 20 minutes after Pill Saint Flura did.
"Now will be the best time to teach her a lesson," Kent smiled and started refining his pill while secretly communicating with the Pill Emperor from the Pyris Pill Alliance.

But Kent had just thrown three main ingredients into the cauldron, and he was extracting the essence without a sigh of discomfort or struggle.
’Who is this monster, and just where did Pill Monarch Nefeli get him from?’ he couldn’t help wondering.
’If these words spread out, people are going to flip.’ A smile appeared on his lips when he realised Kent was from the same Pill Alliance as him.
Kent’s success will reflect positively on the Pyris Pill Alliance.
As for Lady Azela, she was equally shaken when she saw Kent put three ingredients into the cauldron.
She doesn’t know much about alchemy.
However, she knew enough to understand what Kent had done and how shockingly amazing that was.
’He is full of surprises,’ she said inwardly as she continued to look at Kent.
As for Pill Saint Flura, she was so focused on burning the impurities from the essence she had extracted from the ingredients that she didn’t even notice Kent.
In her mind, Kent is cooked, so she might as well ignore him.

Perhaps that was for the best, considering that what Kent was doing wasn’t only too shocking, but he would have made her falter, which, at the state she was in, a slight mistake would be all it would take to destroy everything for her.
After 20 minutes, Kent used his left hand again to make three more ingredients float and enter the cauldron.
This showed he had finished extracting the essence from the first ingredients.
However, while that was impressive, Kent also now had to handle three more extractions while holding onto the three essences he had extracted.
The reason it’s hard is that with the single extraction, he merely had to merge the essences with each other after adding a new ingredient to the cauldron.
This is done step by step, as mixing two essences together not only follows a sacred rule but also has a defined method for every pill.
The three essences he had extracted cannot be mixed; he must hold onto them all the same, extracting the three new ingredients.
After another twenty minutes, Kent added the last three, and within an hour, he had extracted all nine ingredients.
’I have less than two more hours to go,’ Kent thought, and then looked at Pill Saint Flura, who was almost done burning impurities.
’She is rather brilliant.
Looks like she is using the same method as mine. condensing while burning impurities.’ Kent couldn’t help acknowledging his opponent’s intelligence.
However, he wasn’t intimidated.
If anything, he was up for the challenge.
Kent adjusted his flame strength and also began burning impurities.
’Nana taught me how to go about Clean Extraction.
However, that method is too complex.
I don’t have the time to look at that like I did with the method on how to do Dual Extraction.’
In truth, Nana had done more than Kent said.
Before meeting her, Kent had only four enlightenments, all of which were related to pill refining.
In fact, Kent had been aiming for Dual Extraction when he learned of how amazing the Pill Princess was.
So he delved deeper into that, and when he met Nana, she took him even further.
The methods she showed Kent are Dual Extraction, which, thanks to the three enlightenments he had after, has now deepened his understanding to the point where he has achieved Triple Extraction.
The second is Dual Pill Concoction, which involves creating two pills simultaneously.
For that, Kent can’t start to think of it since even Pill Monarchs can only attempt that with Tier 9 and below pills.
The third, however, pertains to Clean Extraction.
This method is something Kent used during the extraction process, which, from the look of things, he still needed to practice some more.
The ideal result was for him to extract an impurity-free essence from the ingredients, which, if achieved, would enable him to condense and refine the pill without concern for impurities.
If Kent had extracted the herbs one by one, he would have achieved that, but with Triple Extraction, there was some residue of impurities in the extracted essence.
However, the impurities left in the medicinal essence aren’t significant, so Kent chose to proceed with the best course of action, which involves simultaneously condensing and burning the impurities.
As he changed the flame technique, the Pill Sovereigns on the last floor and a few others on the 6th, 7th, and 8th floors raised their brows.
Most recognised what Kent was doing, and while they could do the same, a Pill Grandmaster has no business doing that.
In fact, most stood from their seats and appeared on the 5th floor just to witness Kent’s brilliance.
Within minutes, a powerful Alchemist appeared on the 5th floor, but Kent ignored them all, for he knew what he was doing was something extraordinary.
Half an hour later, Pill Saint Flura’s pill formed, and the smell of a Pure Bone Tempering Pill spread all over, causing many to admire her brilliance.
It was already three and a half hours since the start of the contest, but she had already formed her pill.
Naturally, that is something worth being proud of.
Pill Saints had no business concocting Tier 8 and 9 pills.
Those are meant for Pill Sages.
However, the brightest in the Pill Path can be extraordinary.
It was also one of the many reasons why there are not many Pill Sages with extraordinary talents.
Most Pill Saints, once they become Pill Sages, will, within months, take the Pill King Trial, which requires them to concoct three Tier 9 pills within 24 hours.
However, even without these rankings, what Pill Saint Flura had done was already amazing.
However, she was overshadowed by Kent, who also condensed his pill 20 minutes after Pill Saint Flura did.
"Now will be the best time to teach her a lesson," Kent smiled and started refining his pill while secretly communicating with the Pill Emperor from the Pyris Pill Alliance.

chapters.title: Chapter 949: Pill Rings
paragraphs: "You wouldn’t happen to know a thing or two about Pill Rings, would you?" Kent’s voice entered the Pill Emperor’s head, causing him to blink a couple of times before responding.
"Why did you ask?"
"Nothing too serious. I just want to find out how it will help me to win the duel."

The man raised his brow, unsure how to handle what Kent had just said. "Are you being serious? Pill Rings are something Pill Monarchs and higher dare talk about. What does a Pill Grandmaster know about Pill Rings?"
Kent smiled. "I don’t, so that was why I asked. Now, can you tell me a thing or two about Pill Rings?"
The Pill Emperor sighed.
"I don’t know much, mainly because I have no business learning about that yet. However, from what I know, Pill Rings are like a boost to the pill.

There are eight of them, to the best of my knowledge, with rumours even suggesting that there is a ninth ring. I only know of the first two rings, and that is thanks to witnessing a duel between two Pill Sovereigns.

The first is the Grey Ring, which, from its name, appears grey around the pill. Each ring comes in three qualities: Low, Medium, and High. A low-grade Grey Pill Ring on a pill will give it a 10% extra boost in purity.
The Medium Grey Pill Ring will give the pill a 30% boost, while the High Grey Pill Ring will give the pill a 50% boost.
The second is the Green Pill Ring.
That one is a step up from the grey pill ring. From what I know, a low-grade Green Pill Ring provides an 80% boost in purity, while a high-grade Green Pill Ring offers a 120% boost.

This means that if you manage to concoct a Tier 9 Pure pill, forming a high-grade green pill ring will increase the purity to 220%, which we both know will make the pill several times richer and more potent.
I don’t know why you ask, but know that Pill Rings are what determine the quality of pills in the Immortal Worlds.
Down here in the Supreme High Worlds, we only have the Purity levels since even Pill Sovereigns can boast their chest and say they can easily form Pill Rings."
Kent smiled behind his cauldron, knowing full well that if he managed to pull off the Pill Ring, not only would he be winning the duel, he would become an instant hit in the pill world.
Naturally, he was already looking forward to that.
If he had been recognised in the path of the sword in the future, then he wanted his name to spread too in the pill paths in the past.
’Nana said I can only form one Pill Ring at my current level. However, she said nothing about the grade I will be coming out with.’

Kent, who didn’t know if this was going to end well, considering he had yet to try the Pill Ring Refining Technique, sighed in his head and closed his eyes, sending a part of his consciousness into the Sword Mind space that had now turned into a Pill Room.
He started slow as he dived into the technique. He didn’t know what would happen, so he planned to get familiar with the technique before using it.
Naturally, before he came to the pill duel, he brushed through the technique, but because he wasn’t really looking forward to using it, he didn’t pay close attention.
He expected Pill Saint Flura to be of the standards of the Medium World since she was merely a replacement for the Pill Princess back in the Supreme Immortal Sect.
However, he was struck dumb when he saw what the Pill Saint could do. In a way, Kent underestimated her.
After thirty minutes, Kent became familiar with the technique.
’With the flame I am using, I will be able to form only a low-grade Grey Pill Ring,’ Kent said, looking at Pill Saint Flura, who was wrapping up her refining.
The onlookers were shocked by Kent’s display. However, since the Pill Saint was wrapping up, they knew the winner had been determined.
One of the winning factors is the time spent making their pill. If they both were to get the same pill purity, they would have to use the time taken to complete the refining to determine the winner.
"This kid has a great future."
"Indeed. He has proven to all of us that it doesn’t matter the ranking; provided you have the means, you can easily defy all odds."
"I will never forget today’s experience."
"Me too. It will be rooted in my mind, and years to come, if I am still living, I will tell today’s display by this kid to my great-grandchildren."
A few minutes later, Pill Saint Flura wrapped up and took out a pure white pill and placed it in a pill bottle.

She turned and looked at Kent, who was staring back at her with a smile on his face. Naturally, the gloating she planned on gloating was caught in her mouth. The smile on Kent’s face was like he had set a trap for her, and she fell for it.
This made her narrow her eyes at Kent’s cauldron. She saw the white pill in the cauldron, but despite knowing she also had the same pill, she couldn’t help feeling she had lost.
"I know what you are thinking," Kent said, slapping the side of his cauldron, causing the white pill in his cauldron to fly out.
However, instead of catching it and placing it into a pill bottle, he extended his hand and formed a ring of flame around it, causing it to hover in the air.
This stunned everyone, causing them to stand on their feet, including the Pill Sovereigns on the last floor of the pagoda.
"Why the hell do I have a smile on my face when I am clearly lagging behind in the time of completion?" Kent smiled, looking away from Pill Saint Flura.
On the stands, all those recording this duel channelled their energy into their recording crystal, allowing them to capture the audio much more clearly.
"The answer is simple, Pill Saint Flura. I am better than you, and deep down, you know that. You can feel it deep within you.

However, while you still think you have the upper hand, why don’t you ask yourself this important question? If the winning is determined using the purity or the time of completion, then why hasn’t he stopped refining his pill?" Kent laughed.
"I mean, one can’t go beyond 100%, right?" The look on the Pill Saint’s face changed. She could sense it, or more accurately, feel it; something wasn’t right.
"I mean, what could possibly make one gain purity more than 100%?" This time, the onlookers were also brought to the same thought processes as the Pill Saint.

One of them, a Pill King, blurted out what he was thinking. "The only way for a pill to surpass 100% purity is if you can form a Pill Ring. However, not even I have the means... Don’t tell me this kid thinks he can form a Pill Ring."
Kent, who heard him, turned toward him and smiled. Then he formed a hand seal, and the flame ring around the pill began to spin.
"No way," a Pill Emperor who came from the 7th floor muttered, looking at a faint grey ring slowly appearing around the pill.
"He is actually doing it."
With widened eyes and jaws hanging by a thread, Kent started to slowly form the Pill Ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 950: End of the Pill Duel
paragraphs: "This is impossible," Pill Sovereign Ric exclaimed, his face showing a shocked expression as he looked at the grey mark slowly appearing around Kent’s pill.
"Can’t say impossible, considering it is now plain before our eyes," Pill Sovereign Okra said with an expression that couldn’t be read.
His gaze was directed at Kent, who had no idea what was going on through the Pill Sovereign’s head.
Pill Sovereign Ric looked at Pill Sovereign Bryn, who was watching Kent. Nobody could tell what was going on in his head. However, one thing was certain: he would never let Kent leave easily.
Even if Kent failed to form a Pill Ring, he would declare him the winner and use his power to make him stay.
If only he knew there was an asteroid with his name on it, he wouldn’t even dare think of playing dirty.

Meanwhile, Pill Saint Flura, who thought she had won, was now looking at Kent with wide eyes. In her years spent walking the Pill Path, she had never stopped to think a mere Pill Grandmaster would have the means to defeat her, and that her defeat would come in the form of a Pill Ring, something not even Pill Monarchs could brag they could easily do.
Even Pill Sovereigns couldn’t boldly claim they could form Pill Rings. Most only formed Pill Rings during the Pill Tribulations.
If the Pill Dao determined your pill’s worth, they could add a ring as a form of Pill Blessing.
However, not many could say they had the means to form their own Pill Rings and even to some extent do so while smiling with a relaxed face.
What Kent was doing defied common sense, leaving every onlooker in great shock.
Kent looked at Pill Saint Flura when there were only 20 more minutes for the 5-hour duration of the duel to end, and smiled.

"No need to look sour, young lady. The only reason why you are in this predicament is because you grew cocky, thinking you are better than everyone." Kent formed a hand seal and pointed it at the pill, making the grey rings around the pill more visible now.

"I have to admit, you are a brilliant Alchemist, there is no doubt about that. However, until you are alone at the peak, never think you are better than everyone. Trust me, there are monsters hidden in sheep’s clothing looking at you with contempt and disgust.

So let this be a lesson to you. In the near future, no matter your achievements, regardless of your understanding in the Pill Path, whenever you feel like gloating, remember me, for I will forever be better than you." Kent laughed.

If what Kent said sounded like motivation, then the last sentence shattered everything. His words made everyone who heard him enter a deep thought, but considering what Kent had achieved, some couldn’t help but wonder if they even had a future in the Pill Path.
But Kent wasn’t done. This time, he used the soul map to speak only to Pill Saint Flura.
"I hope you have learned your lesson from this defeat. We may be opponents, or to some extent enemies, but know that I came to accept your duel today because the Pill Dao willed it.

I knew you from nowhere, yet I was told to come accept your duel. Truly, this wasn’t a coincidence at all. So if you hate me, fine, I already have more haters than I could count, so adding you to the list is nothing.
However, know this: the fact that the Pill Dao sent me means they have their eyes on you. They recognised your potential, and that alone should tell you what you need to know.

We might never meet again, but even if we did, there is a feeling that you will become my senior. In that case, I hope you will one day find it in your heart to forgive this junior and see him as a worthy opponent.
Then again, the reason why you were defeated by me is that I am just too awesome."
With a smile on Kent’s face, the flame ring around the pill dispersed, revealing a white pill with a grey ring around it.
"A low grey Pill Ring," Pill Sovereign Ric muttered, appearing in the air over the stage. The other two Pill Sovereigns appeared a second later, each bearing a stunned expression.
"Little brother, do you perhaps want to sell this pill?" Pill Sovereign Ric said, waving his hand as the pill moved toward him.
Kent raised his head and looked at the Pill Sovereign, who held a "better make the right choice, else you won’t be leaving here in one piece" gaze.
Kent saw this and smiled, "Per the Ancient rules of Pill making, the winner of the duel has three decisions they can make.
First, they can either take their pill and leave, at which point the opponents or their organisation can do nothing about that.
Second, the winner can choose to gift the pill to their opponent. Whatever they do with that is none of his business.
Lastly, the winner can auction the pill, and the highest bidder gets to keep it.
However, since this Pill Alliance welcomed me with open arms, I can’t in good conscience choose options one and three, so I gift this pill to my opponents."
Kent smiled slyly while the three Pill Sovereigns looked at Kent in a new light.
If there is one thing Alchemists respect, it is the rules set during Ancient times that are still being followed to the last detail.
The reason it is still being followed is that, through experience, it was discovered that these rules were enforced by the Pill Dao, so nobody dares go against them.
It is said that whenever someone invokes the Pill rules in their argument, they, in a subtle way, are telling everyone the Pill Dao is their witness, so going against them is not an option.
If now, the three Pill Sovereigns want to seize Kent and force him to join them, then that thought is now wiped from their heads.
However, since Kent had given the pill to someone from the Aerithyne Pill Alliance, it was akin to giving it to the Alliance, meaning he hadn’t offended anyone.
The three Pill Sovereigns looked at Pill Saint Flura, who was quick to let them have it.
"Great, because of your contribution to the Alliance, you can have a two-week audience with the Celestial Cloud Feather," Pill Sovereign Bryn said before vanishing back to the 9th floor.
Everyone around was left stunned, unsure of what to make of it.
Kent won in the most shocking way possible, yet his opponent was just awarded a two-week audience with the Celestial Cloud Feather, said to enhance one’s understanding of their pill techniques.
Just studying their techniques in the presence of the Celestial Cloud Feather is enough to let them grow several years within a day.
For her to get two weeks is already too much.
While Kent was looking at where the Pill Sovereigns had gone, Pill Saint Flura stood up and offered the Pill Ascension Token to him with a slight bow.
"Thank you," Kent said, receiving the token.
"No, I should thank you. In a way, you have helped me more than I could have ever expected. If we meet next time, I will be sure to pay you back."

Without knowing the kind of payback she was talking about, Pill Saint Flura flew away and headed straight home to learn a technique she had been meaning to learn before coming to spend two weeks with the Celestial Cloud Feather.
Kent also left a few seconds later and met up with Lady Azela and the Pill Emperor.ree

Just studying their techniques in the presence of the Celestial Cloud Feather is enough to let them grow several years within a day.
For her to get two weeks is already too much.
